title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Forward Development
description:
**Are you an AI-driven Software Engineer and a Game Changer?** 




  





**At St1, we believe data and AI will be a game changer for the energy industry, and we're not waiting to find out. We've already rolled up our sleeves and got to work. We're investing in the team, tools, and culture to lead that shift, and the people we hire now will shape how it happens.** 




  





**St1 is an energy transition company with the vision to be the leading producer and seller of CO₂-aware energy. St1 operates in Finland, Sweden, Norway, and the United Kingdom. St1’s energy portfolio encompasses oil products, biogas, Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), renewable diesel (HVO) and solar power. Furthermore, St1 is advancing various major energy transition projects, including transition investments at the oil refinery in Gothenburg. St1 has 1,150 retail stations in Finland, Sweden and Norway. St1’s retail network offers marketplaces with fuels, growing number of EV charging and biogas filling points for heavy-duty transport as well as car wash, alongside stand-alone convenience stores and restaurants. Together, we’re more than 1,000 curious, committed and caring people here to change the game. Ready to challenge the ordinary with us?** 




  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join St1's Software Engineering team, a team which operates at the intersection of St1's energy transition journey and modern software development. We handle the full lifecycle of software products and solutions across multiple business domains. Charging or fueling your car, getting it through an automatic car wash, or tracking how cooking oil becomes sustainable biofuel: all of it happens with software our team builds.
 



  





 You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and technical specialists, from early scoping through to delivery. This is a forward-deployed role: you are as comfortable in a room with the business as you are in detailed analysis of the solution. You bring technical depth to the discussion, and communication skills are as important as tech competence.
 



  





 The AI dimension of this role goes beyond using a coding assistant. We are actively rethinking how software engineering should be done in the age of AI: building AI-integrated pipelines, working with agents, and exploring what it looks like when humans and AI work as a team. We expect you to have solid hands-on experience with available AI tools, and the curiosity to keep pushing further.
 



  





**How you’ll help drive the change** 




  





 Joining St1, you’ll be part of running and developing a profitable business that invests in long-term energy solutions. Together we achieve the extraordinary through everyday work. As a
 **Software Engineer,** 
 you’ll play a key role in…
 



  




* Being part of a forward-deployed delivery team working across one or several business domains, bridging the gap between what is technically possible and what the business and customers need.
* Working with business stakeholders, architects, technical specialists, and AI agents on requirements analysis and technical design, from early scoping through to delivery.
* Planning, implementing, and validating solutions with your team, and ensuring a reasonable level of maintenance and operational support.
* Providing technical leadership and helping align development practices across teams, not just your own solutions. Championing efficiency, transparency, and scalability in how we build products.
* Building AI-integrated development pipelines and tools, working with agents, testing agentic approaches, and helping the team adopt AI-native ways of working.
* Challenging existing ways of working and helping us rethink how software engineering should be done now.
* Keeping an eye on the technology landscape and making sure what we propose today does not become a problem tomorrow.



  





**What you bring to the team** 




  





 We’re looking for a colleague with the drive to challenge, collaborate and grow. To thrive in this role, you likely have:
 



  





 Strong software engineering foundation with genuine AI-native experience. You do not need years of AI expertise, but you do need to have built things with it, encountered its limitations, and be ready to help us rethink what software engineering looks like from here.
 


* Solid experience with microservice architecture and distributed systems.
* Full-stack background with a strong backend focus.
* Fluency in Node.js (NestJS), TypeScript, .NET Core, and C#. Modern frontend frameworks (Next.js, React, Vue.js) are a plus.
* Experience with Google Cloud; hands-on with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with architecture patterns such as DDD, SOLID, Hexagonal, and MVC, and the judgment to know when to apply them.
* The ability to write clean, testable, maintainable code and to work with established systems that were not built yesterday.
* Hands-on experience with modern AI building blocks: LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases and embeddings, agent frameworks, and emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Clear communication in both directions: you listen well and you explain things in a way that lands, whether the audience is technical or not.
* Autonomy: you drive things forward without needing to be chased.
* A solution-oriented and collaborative nature.
* 6+ years in software development.
* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Professional English; knowledge of a Nordic language is a plus.



  





**Who are we looking for** 




  





 We are looking for your passion, skills and drive. We're looking for those who recognize the St1 Spirit in themselves: Curious, Commercial, Committed and Caring. This Spirit shows up in daily actions: creating a space where it is safe to be yourself and raise problems early, following through when delivery gets tough, thinking end-to-end rather than in silos, and learning faster than the environment changes. Let us know what you can and want to do.
 



  





**Why Join St1?** 




  




* A role at the frontier of AI-forward engineering: you will help shape how St1 builds software in the age of AI, not just use the tools others have decided on.
* Real business impact across multiple domains: your work touches products used by real people every day.
* A role that grows with you: we invest in people, and there is room to go deeper into architecture, AI, data engineering, or technical leadership.
* A talented Nordic Business Technology organization where each individual counts.
* A great working culture with a genuine combination of freedom and responsibility. You can make a real difference.
* Helsinki or Stockholm base and a generous social package.
* St1's vision is to be the leading producer and seller of CO2-aware energy. Every role contributes to that goal.



  





**How we support your journey** 




  





 At St1, your safety and wellbeing come first. We offer an open and inclusive workplace where you’re respected and trusted to take initiative. In a hands-on, informal culture — and a business that never stands still — there’s room to explore ideas and take on new challenges. We support your journey through learning and opportunities to grow across teams and countries.
 



  





 You’ll have real technical ownership of the software St1 runs on, working with a wide range of teams; backed by competitive pay, a bonus scheme and genuine opportunities to grow your career.
 



  





**If you’d like to explore more about our culture, visit our career site.** 




  





**What to expect after you apply** 




  





 We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and equitable recruitment process.
 



  





 Interested? Send us your CV and cover letter via the Barona Career site no later than on Monday, 7th of September 2026.
 



  





 The recruitment process will be conducted in collaboration with Barona.
 



  





**Let’s challenge the ordinary** 




  





**It takes more than expected to research, develop, produce and invest in the energy transition. But you're not like everyone else – and neither is St1. Step forward and bring what only you can. Together, we make the extraordinary happen through everyday work.**

title: Sr. Frontend Engineer – Streaming Experience Player
description:
****Hos TV4 möts teknik, innovation, nyhetsjournalistik, sport och underhållning.****
 Vi bygger Nordens största streamingtjänst som i snitt når cirka åtta miljoner nordbor i veckan genom TV4 Play och vår finska motsvarighet MTV Katsomo. Inom Product, Tech & Operations utvecklar vi de tekniska lösningar som bland annat gör det möjligt att streama innehåll, söka och få rekommendationer, så att människor kan ta del av allt vårt innehåll när och var de vill.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en
 **Senior Frontend Engineer** 
 som, med stöd av AI, utformar, bygger och förvaltar vår spelarupplevelse på alla plattformar, från arkitekturbeslut till implementation.
   

  

**Om teamet**
 Streaming Experience Player är teamet som ser till att användarna har en förstklassig upplevelse från det att de klickar på
 **Play** 
 : snabb och pålitlig videouppspelning, engagerande UX och sömlös annonsintegration oavsett plattform.
   

  

 Även om teamets fokus är tydligt är ansvarsområdet brett. En videospelare innehåller många rörliga delar och en vanlig dag kan innehålla allt från prestandaoptimering på låg nivå till att bolla UI med en designer. Kunskapsdelning och att växa tillsammans är en självklar del av hur vi arbetar.
   

  

 Vi bygger uppspelningslagret i native och UI-lagret i React och React Native. Uppspelningslagret innehåller bland annat kod för DRM, ABR, reklamuppspelning, nätverk och analys, medan UI-lagret utgör kontaktytan mot användarna och resten av appen.
   

  

****Vad du kommer att göra****
 Som Senior Frontend Engineer kommer du jobba tätt tillsammans med andra inom teamet och i resten av organisationen. Du samarbetar med frontend- såväl som backend-fokuserade team för att leverera bästa möjliga upplevelse till miljontals tittare.
   

  

 Du kommer att ansvara för våra lösningar från ax till limpa - från idé till implementation, monitorering och kontinuerlig förbättring. I alla dessa faser är AI en central del i hur du jobbar: från skräddarsydda utvecklingsverktyg och felsökning till vältestad, produktionsredo kod.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat:
   

  

* Bygga och underhålla högpresterande videospelare för Android, Android TV, iOS, tvOS och webbaserade plattformar såsom webbläsare, Chromecast, LG och Samsung TV.
* Jobba agentiskt genom hela kedjan - vi arbetar idag med Claude Code och OpenAI Codex, och alla förväntas arbeta aktivt med att optimera våra arbetssätt kring dagens och framtidens AI-verktyg.
* Skriva designdokument och tekniska specifikationer som grund för välförankrade beslut.
* Äga observability och monitorering av de videospelare du bygger och ansvarar för.


****Om dig****
 Du är en erfaren frontend- eller fullstackutvecklare med ett genuint intresse för användarupplevelse, kvalitet och moderna utvecklingsmetoder. Du tycker om komplexa tekniska problem men drivs ytterst av att skapa produkter som fungerar bättre för användaren.
   

  

 Vi tror också att du:
   

  

* Har minst fem års erfarenhet av av modern frontend-utveckling, och kan se helheten kring dina tekniska lösningar och hur de passar in i ett större sammanhang.
* Har erfarenhet av en snabbrörlig miljö med höga krav på självledarskap.
* Förstår att de flesta tekniska beslut sällan är svartvita, och aktivt söker rätt balans.
* Fullt ut har anammat AI som verktyg för att lyfta din och ditt teams leverans.
* Nördar ner dig på riktigt när något fångar dig - oavsett om det handlar om distribuerade system, AI, eller matlagning. Du blir rastlös när du slutar lära dig.
* Är en god kommunikatör och kan förklara komplexa koncept på ett enkelt vis.


 Det är ett extra plus om du har erfarenhet av Android-utveckling i Kotlin, då vi vill stärka den kompetensen inom teamet.
   

  

****Nuvarande tech stack****
**UI-ramverk**
 React, React Native
   

  

**Språk**
 Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript
   

  

**Videouppspelning**
 Media3/ExoPlayer, AVFoundation, Shaka, hls.js
   

  

**Streaming-teknologier**
 HLS, DASH, DRM, SSAI, CSAI
   

  

**AI & Developer Tooling**
 Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, CLI/MCP
   

  

**Produktivitet**
 Linear, Notion, Slack
   

  

****Vad TV4 erbjuder dig****
* Kort väg från idé till beslut i en senior teknikorganisation med hög autonomi för team och individ.
* Möjlighet att bygga en streamingupplevelse som används av miljontals människor varje vecka.
* Kollegor med hög teknisk kompetens och stort ägandeskap.
* En kultur som prioriterar långsiktiga tekniska lösningar framför genvägar.
* Du loggar ut på riktigt efter jobbet. Vi har dedikerad on-call där det är relevant och förväntar oss inte att du ska vara tillgänglig utanför arbetstid.
* Modernt kontor med gym, restaurang, garage och takterrass.
* Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar, friskvårdsbidrag, Benify, val av telefon och MacBook Pro.


****Praktisk information****
* TV4 är office-first och vi arbetar från kontoret fyra dagar i veckan.
* Tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.
* Facklig tillhörighet: Unionen.
* Bakgrundskontroll ingår i rekryteringsprocessen.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer – Hybrid
description:
*Vill du ta ditt konsultande till nästa nivå hos Sveriges bästa arbetsgivare? Vi vet vad du tänker. Du har hört det förut. Men tro oss, det har du inte. Vårt körsbär på konsulttårtan är något annat. Sök jobbet och smaka själv!*
 Vi söker en
 **Senior DevSecOps Engineer** 
 till ett långsiktigt uppdrag hos en samhällskritisk verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet inom
 **DevSecOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Linux och IT-säkerhet** 
 och som trivs i en kombination av strategiskt, koordinerande och praktiskt tekniskt arbete.
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta nära agila utvecklingsteam och vara med och vidareutveckla organisationens förmåga att utveckla, testa och driftsätta säkra IT-lösningar. Ett centralt fokus är att integrera IT-säkerhet som en naturlig del av hela utvecklings- och leveransprocessen.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 I uppdraget kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Vidareutveckla plattformar, verktyg och arbetssätt inom DevSecOps, CI/CD och containerplattformar.
* Stödja utvecklingsteam, projekt och förvaltningar i införandet av DevSecOps-baserade arbetssätt.
* Integrera säkerhet i utvecklings- och leveransprocesser.
* Arbeta hands-on med Kubernetes/OpenShift, GitOps, Linux och CI/CD-miljöer.
* Installera, konfigurera och vidareutveckla tekniska miljöer och plattformar.
* Delta i risk- och sårbarhetsanalyser samt andra aktiviteter inom IT- och informationssäkerhet.
* Felsöka incidenter och problem samt stötta team vid säkerhetsrelaterade frågor.
* Koordinera tekniska förändringar tillsammans med interna och externa intressenter och leverantörer.
* Dokumentera lösningar och bidra till kunskapsspridning inom DevSecOps och IT-säkerhet.
* Utbilda och stötta andra medarbetare inom området.


 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* Minst 10 års erfarenhet som systemutvecklare och/eller IT-tekniker, inklusive arbete med drift eller förvaltning av egenutvecklade applikationer.
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av DevSecOps i CI/CD-miljöer, där IT-säkerhet varit integrerad i utvecklings- och leveransprocessen.
* Erfarenhet av att ha infört DevSecOps-arbetssätt och tillhörande verktyg i minst två större projekt.
* Minst 3 års praktisk erfarenhet av GitOps-driven Kubernetes eller OpenShift i produktionsmiljö.
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av scripting i Linuxmiljö, exempelvis Bash eller Python.
* Relevant IT-utbildning alternativt mycket lång arbetslivserfarenhet inom IT.
* Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


 Praktisk information
   

  

**Start:** 
 7 januari 2027
   

  

**Omfattning:** 
 100 %
   

  

**Uppdragslängd:** 
 Initialt till 6 januari 2028, med möjlighet till förlängning
   

  

**Distans:** 
 Upp till 50 %, med arbete på plats cirka 2–3 dagar per vecka
   

  

 Låter det här som ett uppdrag för dig? Hör gärna av dig så berättar vi mer.
   

  

**Bara det bästa åt de bästa – vår personalfilosofi**
 Castra är en konsultgrupp inom IT och Management. Eller ja, en elite squad kan man säga. Vi samlar de vassaste och mest erfarna konsulterna, helt enkelt för att det är hos oss de får ut max i både kapacitet och livskvalitet. Vi är verksamma inom Systemutveckling, IT-infrastruktur, IT-styrning & Ledarskap samt IT-säkerhet.
   

  

 Vi är utsedda till Sveriges- och Europas bästa arbetsplats, på riktigt! Det låter lite skrytsamt, men det är faktiskt inte vi som sagt det. Castra har sedan 2017 blivit certifierad av
 **Great Place to Work,** 
 en utmärkelse som är helt baserat på medarbetarundersökningar. Vi har de senaste tre åren blivit utnämnda till
 **Sveriges Bästa Arbetsplats** 
 för stora bolag och nu senast kammade vi även hem förstaplatsen bland
 **Europas Bästa Arbetsplatser** 
 . Som grädde på moset är vi även ett Gasell- och Karriärföretag!
   

  

 På Castra tror vi på frihet, utveckling och gemenskap. Du som konsult styr själv vilka uppdrag du tar, när du jobbar, om du vill levla upp någon kompetens och hur och mycket lön och semester du tar ut. Att du får bygga din egen logga är bara en bonus! Trodde du det var allt? Då trodde du fel. Stöd av bra chefer, aktiviteter, kompetent och snabbfotad säljstyrka, möjlighet till delägarskap, stora möjligheter att påverka bolagets framtid och härliga kollegor – listan på vad som gör Castra till en fantastisk arbetsplats kan göras lååång. Möjligheterna bra nära oändliga. Win för alla parter, säger vi.
   

  

*Castra har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Malmö, Linköping, Norrköping, Örebro, Jönköping och Sundsvall.*
 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss på castra.se/konsulterbjudande/
   

  

**Har vi lyckats väcka din nyfikenhet?**
 Sök direkt via länken eller hör av dig till Charlotta.Ljung@Castra.se

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:

 is seeking a highly skilled and experienced

 to join our team in
 **Sweden** 
 (located in Gothenburg OR Stockholm).
   

  

 Our

 candidate has strong problem-solving skills, an analytical mindset and the ability to lead the integration of security into the development and operations processes.

title: DevOps Engineer – Data & Analytics | SEB, Solna
description:

 We are an agile department working on building a scalable, sustainable and reliable data platform to provide exceptional experience for our customers.  Together with your colleagues you will be responsible for on-boarding new tooling to our stack. Everything with security and automation in mind. You will have the opportunity to broaden your competence and will be given a generous amount of time for your own ideas and projects. title: DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure & Databricks)
description:
**Do you enjoy creating secure, scalable cloud environments that enable innovation at enterprise scale?**
 As a
 **DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure & Databricks)** 
 , you will help operate and develop the platforms that support Vattenfall’s data, analytics and AI ambitions. Your expertise in Azure, automation and cloud governance will contribute directly to our purpose: enabling fossil-free living through digital innovation and smarter use of data.
   

  

**Your role**
 Within our Digital Platform Operations team, you will work with colleagues across
 **cloud engineering** 
 ,
 **architecture** 
 ,
 **operations** 
 and
 **data platforms** 
 to ensure that our
 **Azure and Databricks** 
 environments remain secure, reliable and future-ready.
   

  

 You will play a key role in advancing a modern enterprise data platform that enables data-driven decision-making across Vattenfall while continuously improving automation, governance and user experience.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Designing, implementing and operating Azure-based cloud platform solutions
* Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Git and automation tools
* Developing and managing Infrastructure as Code solutions using ARM, Bicep and scripting technologies
* Automate provisioning, deployment and lifecycle management of cloud resources
* Maintaining and improving self-service platform capabilities based on .NET Core and Angular
* Ensuring platform reliability, availability and operational stability
* Supporting administration and continuous improvement of Azure Databricks and Snowflake environments
* Implementing security controls in alignment with enterprise policies and governance requirements
* Collaborating with architects, developers and operations specialists to deliver secure and scalable cloud services


**Azure Databricks Platform Operations & Governance**
* Operating and further developing Vattenfall’s Azure Databricks platform for analytics, data and AI workloads
* Managing identity and access controls through Azure AD integration and RBAC principles
* Supporting secure networking concepts including private endpoints and secure cluster connectivity
* Implementing and maintaining data governance capabilities using Unity Catalog and related Databricks services
* Managing platform resources using Infrastructure as Code approaches such as Terraform and ARM templates
* Establishing compute standards, governance controls and cost optimisation practices
* Enabling integrations with Azure Data Lake, Power BI, Snowflake and other enterprise services
* Supporting onboarding and adoption of platform capabilities across teams
* Contributing to monitoring, logging and security improvements throughout the platform landscape


**Platform Improvement & FinOps**
* Identifying opportunities to improve performance, cost efficiency and sustainability of cloud services
* Enhancing automation and self-service capabilities for platform users
* Supporting the introduction of new cloud, AI and analytics capabilities
* Helping to create a seamless developer and data practitioner experience across the platform ecosystem


**Location**
 Stockholm, Katowice, Amsterdam and Berlin
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Who are you?**
 You bring solid experience from cloud engineering environments and enjoy combining technology, security and automation to create reliable services for users. You are communicative, collaborative and enjoy working together with colleagues from different disciplines to solve complex challenges.
   

  

**We believe you have**
* Several years of experience as a Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer or similar role in Azure environments
* Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, preferably within operations, governance or platform engineering
* Strong understanding of Azure services including Networking, Storage, App Services, Virtual Machines and Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD practices
* Experience working with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as ARM, Bicep, Terraform and PowerShell
* Knowledge of analytics and data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark or modern data lake architectures
* Understanding of cloud governance, security and access management principles
* Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python or similar technologies
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities
* Professional communication skills in English (local language skills are a plus but not mandatory)


**It is an advantage if you also have**
* Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation
* Experience supporting enterprise AI or machine learning platforms


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our offer**
 A challenging and independent job in an informal, dynamic working environment. You can play a part in shaping the future of a company where the only constant is change. Besides being a challenging and inspiring place to work, we value a great work atmosphere!
   

  

 At Vattenfall, we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of gender, age, and ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We believe in work life balance and the flexibility to work from home.
   

  

**More Information**
**We welcome your application in English, no later than,** 
**24th of September 2026** 
 . We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.
   

  

 For more information about the role, please contact the
 **Hiring Manager Mansi Shamsingh Raghuwanshi** 
**: mansishamsingh.raghuwanshi@vattenfall.de** 
 for more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our
 **Recruiter Marius Gläßge (marius.glaessge@vattenfall.de)** 
 .
   

  

**Trade union representatives in Sweden (IT)** 
 are Sofi Wadström (Akademikerna), Patricia Ek (Unionen), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna), Juha Siipilehto (SEKO). To get in contact with the representatives, please call Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.
   

  

 At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.
   

  

 The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA.
   

  

**We look forward to receiving your application!**
**Company Description**
 Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Since you’ve landed on this page, you already know Hedvig is a mover and shaker in insurtech, and think you might have what it takes to join us. We’ve been working hard since the very beginning to change an industry that is hard to love – to something at least likable. At Hedvig, we believe the only way to do so is to work with great people.
 



  





**What about the role?** 




 We are now looking for a Data Scientist to join our ambitious team at Hedvig, to solve complex business problems across the Hedvig using the latest advancements in AI and Machine Learning. The role involves high-impact work designing and developing ML models and agentic AI solutions for fair pricing, reserving, and lifetime value and more.
 



  





 We believe, and know from experience, that we can accelerate faster by owning the entire pipeline from raw data to deployed model, reaping the benefits from developing with AI. Working closely with experienced backend developers, ML engineers, data analysts, and various business teams, you will have the opportunity to shape the data, tools, and innovative solutions that fuel our growth. This offers an inspiring freedom in what you will be able to create.
 



  





 In the role you will:
 



  




* Be a driving force in the development of our proprietary, next generation pricing platform powered by agentic AI development
* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and agentic AI systems to solve challenges across the business, including:
* Engineering dynamic risk models to deliver highly personalized and competitive premium structures that balance fairness with sustainable profitability
* Performing and developing the end-to-end reserving process, blending actuarial analysis with the continuous automation of our workflows
* Driving sales growth by developing and deploying Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models to optimize our marketing strategies
* Drive machine learning and AI projects from project definition and raw data to deployed model and tracking of performance, with full end-to-end ownership
* Evangelize the power of data and AI by promoting your work to the team, stakeholders and Hedvig as a whole
* Be a driving force by always being on the lookout for new trends within AI, and Insurtech



  





**What about you?** 



* **The Foundation:** 
 You hold a Master’s. in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
* **Proven Impact:** 
 Relevant professional experience delivering ML models end-to-end in production, preferably in Fintech or Insurtech. Direct exposure to insurance pricing, actuarial frameworks, or credit risk modeling is a significant advantage that will distinguish your profile.
* **The Generative Frontier:** 
 You are hands-on or experimenting with the modern AI stack, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, and fine-tuning
* **Agentic Thinking:** 
 You have a thirst for building and deploying agentic AI systems capable of complex, multi-step decision-making and tool-use within a business context
* **From Foundations to Frontiers:** 
 You possess a deep algorithmic understanding of machine learning models - from classical GLMs and GBMs to Transformers. You use this knowledge to independently select, develop, interpret, and evaluate the most appropriate solutions for complex problems.
* **Full-Stack Mindset:** 
 You are highly proficient in Python and standard DS libraries, with strong working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing, transforming and working with large datasets for ML.
* **Production-Ready:** 
 Experience deploying and operating ML solutions in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD and best MLOps practices.
* **The AI Advocate:** 
 You thrive in collaborations, translating problems into rigorous quantifiable solutions, and love evangelizing ML models and agentic AI
* **Business impact:** 
 You independently validate models and interpret their performance to make decisions maximising the business impact of them.



  





 Those are not hard requirements! If you have a different profile but you see that you have relevant skills and you think you can do a remarkable job, apply and share with us your motivation on why we should meet you.
 



  





**What about us?** 




 As part of the Hedvig team, you quickly notice that "general truths" are not accepted without being questioned. We're an enthusiastic group of people who love to challenge each other to find the best way forward. We don't care who says something; we care about what's being said. We put a lot of effort into building a trusting culture where freedom, collective thinking, and individual ownership have center stage. We're not perfect – far from it – but we talk about and learn from our mistakes and imperfections to improve continuously. And we have a lot of fun along the way! As individuals, as a team, and as a company.
 



  





 Come join the Hedvig team, including all of our very loved office pups, in newly renovated offices in central Stockholm.

title: DATA SCIENTIST
description:
**Data Scientist Focused on Revenue Management & Network Optimization**
 At SAS, we're passionate about transforming aviation with cutting-edge technology. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making to create smarter customer experiences and stronger commercial performance. As part of our AI Team, you'll shape the future of air travel by creating innovative, data-driven solutions that maximize revenue.
   

  

 You will work on one of the most challenging and rewarding problems in the industry: finding the right price, for the right customer, at the right time. Your work will ensure that the airline's Revenue Optimization remains scientifically robust, operationally scalable, and commercially impactful, directly shaping how revenue is optimized in a dynamic, competitive marketplace.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will center on turning business challenges into well-defined analytical problems and building end-to-end machine learning solutions that deliver measurable impact. You will design, train, and maintain models that power SAS's revenue optimization, ensuring they are accurate, scalable, and production-ready.
   

  

 A priority will be to deliver dynamic pricing, a groundbreaking shift in how SAS competes in the marketplace. At the same time, we are developing AI-driven revenue optimization at scale, ensuring our models continuously learn, adapt, and evolve with industry dynamics.
   

  

 Your work will help SAS unlock the full potential of AI in airline revenue optimization, making smarter pricing and network decisions a reality today.
   

  

 Challenges You Will Work On
   

  

 Machine Learning & Optimization Techniques
   

  

 Build and deploy algorithms that power revenue and network decisions. Among other solutions, you'll develop demand forecasting, purchase probability, and revenue optimization models, leveraging a broad spectrum of AI methods.
   

  

 From classical ensemble methods to deep learning architectures and reinforcement learning frameworks, you'll select the most effective approach for each complex problem.
   

  

 Operations Research
   

  

 Beyond building models, you'll explore new formulations, test novel algorithms and findings that push the boundaries of airline revenue optimization.
   

  

 You will convert advanced research into production-ready optimization and modeling solutions, collaborating with the Operations Research team to embed novel algorithms into initiatives that deliver measurable business impact.
   

  

 MLOps
   

  

 Leverage end-to-end ML infrastructure to take models from research to production at scale. This includes designing reproducible training and inference pipelines, integrating CI/CD workflows for seamless deployment, and ensuring robust monitoring to detect drift and trigger automated retraining, keeping models stable and accurate in production.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are a central machine learning team within SAS Digital & IT that collaborates closely with stakeholders across various business units, identifying business challenges and opportunities that can be addressed through advanced analytics.
   

  

 As SAS continues to strengthen its AI and advanced analytics capabilities, we are investing in modern cloud platforms, scalable machine learning solutions, and engineering practices that enable AI to create measurable value across the business.
   

  

 We work with diverse machine learning projects, collaborate and contribute to the machine learning practice to ensure that we have a solid foundation for SAS to scale and realize the full potential of machine learning.
   

  

 We are now strengthening our team with an experienced Data Scientist focused primarily on optimization projects within Revenue Management and Network, enhancing our advanced analytics capabilities to drive continuous business optimization.
   

  

**To be successful we believe you have**
* Master's Degree or higher with strong mathematics focus (Data Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Optimization, Computer Science) or related field.
* At least 3 years of industry experience within the Data Science domain.
* Proven record of taking on loosely defined problems and translating them into practical applications.
* Strong mathematical background (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, statistics, optimization).
* More than 3 years' experience with Python, SQL and popular machine/deep learning libraries.
* Proficient with statistical and machine learning models (both supervised and unsupervised learning).
* Well-versed in cloud computing. Prior experience with Azure is a big plus.


 We believe you share our passion for data and algorithms. You're self-driven, persistent, creative, and curious, with a strong passion for learning. You seek to understand both the big picture and the intricate details that make it up.
   

  

 Like us, you get excited by commercial opportunities and proactively strive to create business value.
   

  

**Why SAS?**
 Join SAS at an exciting time of technological transformation. Digital & IT is modernizing its technology landscape, strengthening cloud-native capabilities, and expanding the use of AI across the company. As a Data Scientist, you will have the opportunity to work on high-impact optimization challenges, advanced machine learning solutions, and next-generation revenue management capabilities that directly influence commercial performance and customer experience.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.


 Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
   

  

 Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
   

  

 Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
   

  

 Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.
   

  

**Our Culture at SAS**
 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Apply by September 4, 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply early, as the position may be filled before the closing date. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept applications via email.
* This is a full-time position (100%) based at our headquarters in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. We value in-person collaboration, although flexible working arrangements may be available depending on team and business needs.
* As this role contributes to security-classified systems and business-critical capabilities, a background check will be conducted as part of the final stage of the recruitment process.


 If you would like to learn more about the role, the team, or how AI, MLOps, and Generative AI are evolving at SAS, feel free to reach out to Warren Edgren, Head of AI & Automation, at warren.edgren@sas.se.
   

  

 Please note that applications must be submitted through our careers site, as we are unable to process applications received by email.

title: Forward Deployment Lead
description:
**Company** 




 NestAI is a European AI lab for defence delivering the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. We develop adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions.
 



  





 NestOS is our open, modular, and interoperable platform that enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI brings together over 150 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a
 **Forward Deployment Lead** 
 (Forward Deployment Engineering) to join our team full-time in Stockholm. As we are establishing our local office, the role will initially operate in a remote setup, with regular on-site customer visits expected across the Stockholm Metropolitan area and occasional travel elsewhere in Sweden.
 



  





 In this role, you will own the technical delivery and field integration of NestAI’s physical AI systems for our strategic clients. You will combine
 **hands-on engineering execution** 
 with
 **technical project leadership** 
 , taking overall responsibility for delivering mission-critical capabilities directly to customer environments. You will serve as the primary technical anchor for customer deployments by guiding engineering teams, setting execution standards, and connecting client operational requirements with product R&D.
 



  





**Day-to-day responsibilities include:** 



* Technical Project & Field Leadership: Own the end-to-end technical execution of customer deployments, translating complex operational needs into actionable engineering roadmaps and field-ready capabilities.
* Hands-On Engineering Execution: Actively participate in technical integration, software execution, and system testing directly on client engagements alongside deployment teams.
* Deployment Standards & Best Practices: Define and refine technical deployment methodologies, integration patterns, and operational playbooks for field engineering work.
* Connect the Product & Field: Work hand-in-hand with core R&D, Product Managers, and client technical leads to ensure real-world field feedback directly shapes our core platform roadmap.
* Client Interface & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the trusted technical point of contact during on-site integration, field trials, and capability handovers.
* Delivery Velocity & Risk Management: Track technical deliverables, manage system dependencies, and resolve technical blockers in fast-moving, customer-facing environments.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Deep experience (equivalent to 8+ years or so) in software engineering, artificial intelligence, embedded sw engineering or technical delivery, with a strong track record of leading complex, multi-team technical projects.
* Proven ability to lead technical execution, architect solutions, and guide engineering teams through complex customer deployments without direct line-management responsibilities.
* Experience in client-facing technical roles, with good interpersonal skills. You are also able to communicate fluently in Swedish with our local customers.
* Comfortable in dynamic, ambiguous environments. You can create operational clarity for engineers and customers when dealing with shifting field requirements.
* Willingness to travel weekly to customer sites in the Stockholm Metropolitan area and occasionally across Sweden.
* **Pluses:** 
 Strong interest or prior background in IoT, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, robotics, or defence/aerospace technologies.



  





**Why join NestAI** 




 At NestAI, you’ll build meaningful, real-world technology as part of a world-class team of engineers, scientists, and experienced professionals. You’ll work on systems where reliability genuinely matters, contribute to Europe’s security and resilience, and solve problems that demand depth, trust, and craftsmanship.
 



  





 If you want to build with purpose — and with leading experts in the field — you’ve come to the right place.
 



  





**Practicalities** 




 Employment is subject to applicable security screening.
 



  





 As a growing company, we have limited resources to support international relocation, and therefore NestAI is currently focusing on hiring talent already located in Sweden. Remote work from abroad is unfortunately not possible for this position. Relocation within Europe might be an option - if it is an option for you as well, please bring the topic up in your cover letter!
 



  





 NestAI is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential.

* Designed high-quality experiments and have strong sense for effective evaluation
* A natural leader obsessed with building the best technical team in the world
* Mentored team of researchers / engineers, and led collaborative projects across research, engineering, and product teams
* Bonus: Published at top ML/AI conferences on LLMs, code intelligence, or agentic reasoning


**What You’ll Do**
**In one sentence** 
 : Build the most powerful ensemble of LLMs into lovable products.
   

  

* Design and execute experiments grounded in real coding and product use cases
* Define, track and optimize product-centric LLM performance metrics
* Partner with engineering leads to hire and hone a world-class team
* Own training pipelines, distillation workflows, and synthetic data generation systems
* Work closely with infra and product engineers to scale and ship model improvements


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Frontend: React for lightning-fast interfaces
* Backend: Golang and Rust for serious performance
* Cloud: Cloudflare, Google Cloud Run, AWS, Terraform
* DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, observability, infra-as-code


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with the team.
* Complete the take-home exercise
* Show us how you approach problems during two technical interviews
* Join us for trial work lasting 2 days preferably on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Lovable feels right for you.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: WW Junior Light Woven Designer - Edition
description:
* H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H & M here.


**Job Description**

 We are looking for a Junior Light Woven Designer with an elevated fashion sensibility and a commercial eye for Womenswear within our Edition & Campaign collections. ​
   

  





 You will be part of a design environment focused on creating refined womenswear where craftsmanship, quality and meticulous attention to detail guide every step of the process. Our customer is a fashion‑aspirer seeking contemporary pieces that balance timeless tailoring with modern sophistication—from considered wardrobe essentials to beautifully constructed signature items. Within our collaborative and design‑led team, you will contribute to shaping collections through thoughtful material choices, refined aesthetics and a deep appreciation for proportion, texture and finish. ​
   

  





**What you'll do:**
  

  

  

 ​You will work closely with Senior Designers to build curated Light Woven collections that speak directly to the customer while remaining aligned with the overarching brand direction. You will ensure that the Edition collection remains elevated, relevant and aligned with our customer’s needs across all global H&M markets.
   

  





 You will be immersed in a highly collaborative environment, working alongside a cross-functional team including Product Managers, Pattern Makers, Print Designers, Planners, Buyers, Product Developers, and Business Controllers. This role offers hands-on exposure across the full design process, from sketching and evolving collection overviews to supporting technical packs and contributing to concept development
   

  





 ​As a person, you thrive in an environment that values craft, clarity and creative precision. You bring strong ownership, a proactive mindset and a refined eye for quality and product excellence. ​
   

  

**​
   

  

 Who you are:**
  

  

  

 ​In addition to the above, we are looking for:​
   

  




* A BA degree in Textile or Fashion Design
* At least 2 years of experience as a Designer within womenswear (previous experience in Light Woven is a plus)
* Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and PLM systems​
* High attention to detail with a refined aesthetic and sharp understanding of elevated womenswear​
* Ability to balance creative vision with commercial thinking and customer relevance​
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate closely with diverse functions​
* Organized, structured and comfortable managing multiple product streams​
* A proactively mindset with strong self‑drive and ability to take initiative​
* You thrive in diverse teams where different perspectives are valued​
* English fluency (Swedish not required)​



 ​
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

 You will report to the Assortment Designer.
   

  





 Please note our Designers are based in our HQ in Stockholm, Sweden. If you are not already based here we would need you to be able to relocate as part of a requirement for these roles. We have a dedicated relocation team to make this as smooth as possible.
   

  





 If your experience, skills, and ambitions are right for this role, please send your application asap including CV and relevant portfolio work (pdf max 10mb/uploading) Portfolio should include vision/mood boards, full design process and final collections and products from a variety of fashion design projects. All documents should be in English. Please ensure to include some work clearly relatable to the aspirational H&M Women’s target customer. We would like see work that shows your creative aspirational side and your sense for commercial fashion.
   

  





 For any internal applicants please have a dialogue with your current manager before applying.
   

  





**Benefits:**
  

 We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
   

  





 In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.
   

  





**Inclusion & Diversity**
  

 H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience, and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process. We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

title: Testare
description:
Vill du arbeta i hjärtat av den svenska demokratin? Nu söker vi en erfaren testare till vårt team, som huvudsakligen arbetar med utveckling av våra kommunikationssystem. Vi söker dig som har ett stort teknikintresse och som vill vara med och kvalitetssäkra it-stöden.
 



  





**Dina arbetsuppgifter** 




 Du blir en del av ett engagerat team som huvudsakligen arbetar med förvaltning och utveckling av vår webbplats och vårt intranät. Du kommer att arbeta både operativt och strategiskt med tester och testautomatisering. I tjänsten ingår också att planera och genomföra det agila testarbetet, vilket inkluderar framtagande av testfall och testdata samt rapportering. Du kommer även att planera och ge stöd vid acceptanstester i nära samarbete med verksamheten.
 



  





**Dina kvalifikationer** 




 Vi söker dig som har
 


* relevant utbildning inom test- och kvalitetssäkring eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* flerårig erfarenhet av systemtestning i både förvaltning och nyutveckling av webbapplikationer
* flerårig erfarenhet av olika testverktyg
* erfarenhet av testautomatisering
* erfarenhet av integrationstestning
* erfarenhet av last-/prestanda-tester
* erfarenhet av användning av SQL-databaser
* erfarenhet av att arbeta nära verksamhet och utvecklare
* förmåga att analysera krav och identifiera risker.



 Det är meriterande med
 


* erfarenhet av programmering, t.ex. C#
* erfarenhet av CMS, t.ex. Optimizely
* kunskap inom CI/CD-verktyg t.ex. Azure Dev Ops Server/Service eller liknande
* kunskap om verktyget Ready API och Playwright
* användning av AI-verktyg i samband med test- och kvalitetssäkring.



  





 Medarbetarskapet är viktigt för oss. Att arbeta hos oss innebär att du förväntas agera i enlighet med vår syn på medarbetarskap: att uppnå resultat, utveckla och samarbeta.
 



  





 Som person trivs du med att arbeta i en agil miljö där samarbete och engagemang står i centrum, samtidigt som du arbetar självständigt och tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt. Din kreativitet hjälper dig att hitta nya lösningar, medan din analytiska förmåga gör att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i komplexa sammanhang och se samband. Du är kvalitets- och säkerhetsmedveten och har förmåga att sätta dig in i olika perspektiv, vilket innebär att du är öppen, tydlig och lyhörd i ditt förhållningssätt.
 



  





 Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid dina personliga egenskaper, särskilt din förmåga att skapa goda, effektiva samarbeten samt att kommunicera i tal och skrift på svenska.
 



  





 Riksdagsförvaltningen tillämpar provanställning.
 



  





 Anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass, vilket i detta fall ställer krav på svenskt medborgarskap och godkänd säkerhetsprövning. Vi välkomnar sökande med olika erfarenheter och bakgrunder.
 



  





**Vi erbjuder dig** 




 I Riksdagsförvaltningen får du jobba med stimulerande, utvecklande och samhällsnyttiga arbetsuppgifter nära demokratins kärna. Här får du yrkesmässiga utmaningar och bra villkor kring semester, tjänstepension, föräldraledighet och kompetensutveckling. I riksdagens lokaler finns gym och träningslokal med olika träningspass varje dag. Vi strävar efter att våra medarbetare ska ha en bra balans mellan jobb och fritid. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete i viss utsträckning.
 



  





**Ansökan** 




 Ansök via www.riksdagen.se, senast den 20 september 2026.
 



 Referensnummer: 2428-2025/26
 



  





 Vi jobbar kompetensbaserat i hela processen och är måna om att erbjuda en inkluderande, rättvis, objektiv och kandidatvänlig process. I denna process ber vi dig att besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor i stället för att skriva ett personligt brev.
 



  





**Övrigt** 




 Riksdagsförvaltningen har gjort sitt medieval för rekrytering och undanber sig alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.
 



  





 Individuell lönesättning tillämpas i enlighet med de centrala kollektivavtalen RD-RALS/RD-RALS 2010-T.

title: DevOps Software Developer
description:
In this role, you will become a central hub in our organization — making the technology and the people behind it work together in the best possible way. Your assignment largely involves driving and developing our build environments, pipelines, and delivery processes, but equally important is your ownership of the relationships and touchpoints around them.
   

  

 You will act as our primary point of contact toward our central Dev/Ops and IT support organization, coordinating and syncing their work with our internal needs. This means moving fluidly between designing complex software and acting as a bridge between different parties. You carry system-wide responsibility, solve technical challenges, and coach your colleagues — but your greatest strength is making things happen through proactive communication and genuine drive.
   

  

* Drive and develop pipelines, build environments, and support systems
* Act as primary point of contact and coordinate collaboration with our central Dev/Ops and IT support organization
* Ensure our delivery processes maintain high quality and meet business requirements
* Coach team members and contribute to a humble, solution-oriented culture


**Requirements**
* Experience with software development and a solid understanding of DevOps and CI/CD fundamentals
* Hands-on experience with common DevOps/CI-CD tooling (e.g. Git, Jenkins/Azure DevOps/GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Strong communication skills and comfort acting as a coordinator between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Solution-focused approach with the ability to structure and prioritize in a complex technical environment
* Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken
* Ability to work on-site in Stockholm


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working in complex, cross-team development environments
* Prior experience coaching or mentoring developers
* Experience collaborating with central IT support or Dev/Ops organizations
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP)


**You will be a great candidate for us if you**
* Are a natural initiative-taker with strong inner drive
* Thrive with many balls in the air and enjoy building structure out of complexity
* Are pedagogical and motivated by helping others grow
* Can see the big picture and understand how technical decisions affect the overall mission
* Value collaboration and communication as much as technical depth


**Benefits**
* Central, high-visibility role bridging technical delivery and business needs
* Opportunity to shape build environments, pipelines, and delivery processes end-to-end
* Close collaboration with a central Dev/Ops and IT support organization
* Coaching and knowledge-sharing culture

title: Platform Engineer - M365 Exchange och Entra ID
description:
Välkommen till Axfood IT, en av matbranschens största IT-avdelningar med ca 400 medarbetare. Det är vi som ser till att Axfood, och alla våra kedjor, kan ligga i framkant vad gäller digital utveckling. Vi jobbar med att utveckla och förbättra allt ifrån e-handel till logistiklösningar och AI.
   

  

 Hos Axfood IT blir du del av ett sammanhang som utmanar och levererar lösningar som gör skillnad, både för våra kollegor och våra kunder. Här finns det alltid möjlighet att lära sig om ny teknik och växa, både som individ och tillsammans med kollegorna.
   

  

**Om teamet**
 I vårt team arbetar vi med att utveckla och förvalta alla typer av lösningar inom Microsoft 365-plattformen, som används i hela Axfoodkoncernen (inklusive Willys, Hemköp och Citygross). Vi som jobbar här har en kombination av bred kompetens inom M365 men också en hel del specialistkompetenser i olika system och tekniker. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och ta nästa steg i vår resa och samtidigt få möjlighet att växa själv, tillsammans med ett team som brinner för att skapa smarta och användarvänliga lösningar för hela Axfood.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 I rollen jobbar du med både förvaltning och vidareutvecklingsprojekt av Entra ID och Exchange, ibland i team och ibland självständigt. Du ansvarar för att leverera stabila, säkra och skalbara lösningar som skapar förutsättningar för verksamheten att lyckas. Du kommer att arbeta nära produktägare och verksamheten för att förstå behov, tolka krav och skapa lösningar som förenklar vardagen för våra användare.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att inkludera:**
* Tolka krav från verksamheten och omsätta dem till stabila, säkra, skalbara och kostnadseffektiva lösningar
* Bidra till kontinuerlig förbättring och innovation inom M365-området
* Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet och driftsäkerhet genom proaktiv övervakning och incidenthantering
* Samarbeta med kollegor i teamet för att dela kunskap och utveckla arbetssätt.


**Stämmer detta in på dig?**
 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med M365 och Exchange, där du både har arbetat med förvaltning och aktivt drivit utveckling. Du är lösningsorienterad, nyfiken och har förmåga att både arbeta självständigt och samarbeta i team. Du behöver inte vara expert på allt, men du är ödmjuk, driven och villig att lära.
   

  

**Vi tror att det är viktigt att du:**
* Har arbetat med utveckling och förvaltning inom M365, inte bara incidenthantering.
* Har kunskap om centralicerade system och molnplattformar
* Förståelse och erfarenhet av Life Cycle Management och Infrastructure as Code.
* Förmåga att analysera och optimera plattformsprestanda samt lösa tekniska problem effektivt
* Är van att tolka krav och kommunicera med verksamheten.
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.


**Vi ser det som strarkt meriterande om du också har:**
* Certifiering inom Microsoft 365 (t.ex. Microsofts Fundamentals).
* Erfarenhet av Entra ID


**Ansökningsprocessen**
 Vi vill att det ska vara enkelt att söka jobb hos oss. Om du inte har ett CV redo räcker det med att du länkar en väl ifylld LinkedIn-profil. I din ansökan får du svara på de frågor vi behöver svar på i den här delen av processen, och personligt brev är därför inte obligatoriskt. Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller tester, intervjuer, bakgrundskontroll och ID-kontroll. Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank-id eller scanna någon QR-kod, men vi kommer be dig styrka din identitet i processens slutskede.
   

  

 Vid frågor om rekrytering på Axfood, kontakta Medarbetarsupporten eller läs mer: Så går det till när du söker jobb inom Axfood. Om du har frågor om tjänsten, kontakta elisabeth.wehlin@axfood.se. Av GDPR-skäl behandlar vi inga ansökningar eller annan personlig information via mail.
   

  

 Läs mer och se filmer om Axfood som arbetsgivare här: Din karriärväg hos Axfood | Utveckling och möjligheter | Axfood

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Are you a Cloud Engineer who enjoys connecting cloud strategy with hands-on delivery? Join a growing team where you can shape cloud solutions and strengthen the link between Cloud and R&D.
   

  

 You will become part of a growing cloud team of around eight colleagues, including experienced specialists, architects, and developers with expertise across different cloud platforms. Together, you will work on cloud solutions involving major platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 Acting as a bridge between Cloud and R&D activities, you will contribute across the full technical landscape, from cloud architecture and holistic planning to hands-on cloud infrastructure implementation. You will also have the opportunity to influence how we develop our cloud business going forward.
   

  

 The role is based at our office in Kista, Stockholm. Since remote collaboration generally works well for this type of work, we also welcome applicants from other parts of Sweden.
   

  

 To succeed in the role, we believe you have:
   

  

* At least three to four years of professional experience working with cloud technologies
* Experience with cloud delivery across multiple projects and one or more major cloud platforms
* The ability to demonstrate your cloud expertise through a certification from one of the major cloud providers
* Experience in both cloud architecture and hands-on cloud infrastructure implementation
* Fluency in Swedish, both spoken and written
* Strong communication skills and an interest in working both holistically and hands-on


 We place great value on personal qualities, communication, and social skills. These strengths help us build flexible teams where colleagues work well together and can rely on support from their peers.
   

  

 What will you get with us?
   

  

 You will work in a collaborative environment with challenging assignments, positive leadership, and experienced colleagues who share their knowledge. The pace is high, but so are the opportunities to develop through innovative projects and established skills development models.
   

  

 Knowit’s culture is grounded in openness, honesty, consensus, and respect for each individual. Sustainability is an important part of how we work, and you will join a team that wants to make a meaningful difference for both our clients and the company.
   

  

 Application
   

  

 We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

**About Knowit**
 Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.
   

  

 Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.
   

  

 We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.
   

  

 We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

title: DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure & Databricks)
description:
**Do you enjoy creating secure, scalable cloud environments that enable innovation at enterprise scale?**
 As a
 **DevOps Cloud Engineer (Azure & Databricks)** 
 , you will help operate and develop the platforms that support Vattenfall’s data, analytics and AI ambitions. Your expertise in Azure, automation and cloud governance will contribute directly to our purpose: enabling fossil-free living through digital innovation and smarter use of data.
   

  

**Your role**
 Within our Digital Platform Operations team, you will work with colleagues across
 **cloud engineering** 
 ,
 **architecture** 
 ,
 **operations** 
 and
 **data platforms** 
 to ensure that our
 **Azure and Databricks** 
 environments remain secure, reliable and future-ready.
   

  

 You will play a key role in advancing a modern enterprise data platform that enables data-driven decision-making across Vattenfall while continuously improving automation, governance and user experience.
   

  

****Your Key Responsibilities:****
* Designing, implementing and operating Azure-based cloud platform solutions
* Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Git and automation tools
* Developing and managing Infrastructure as Code solutions using ARM, Bicep and scripting technologies
* Automate provisioning, deployment and lifecycle management of cloud resources
* Maintaining and improving self-service platform capabilities based on .NET Core and Angular
* Ensuring platform reliability, availability and operational stability
* Supporting administration and continuous improvement of Azure Databricks and Snowflake environments
* Implementing security controls in alignment with enterprise policies and governance requirements
* Collaborating with architects, developers and operations specialists to deliver secure and scalable cloud services


****Azure Databricks Platform Operations & Governance:****
* Operating and further developing Vattenfall’s Azure Databricks platform for analytics, data and AI workloads
* Managing identity and access controls through Azure AD integration and RBAC principles
* Supporting secure networking concepts including private endpoints and secure cluster connectivity
* Implementing and maintaining data governance capabilities using Unity Catalog and related Databricks services
* Managing platform resources using Infrastructure as Code approaches such as Terraform and ARM templates
* Establishing compute standards, governance controls and cost optimisation practices
* Enabling integrations with Azure Data Lake, Power BI, Snowflake and other enterprise services
* Supporting onboarding and adoption of platform capabilities across teams
* Contributing to monitoring, logging and security improvements throughout the platform landscape


**Platform Improvement & FinOps**
* Identifying opportunities to improve performance, cost efficiency and sustainability of cloud services
* Enhancing automation and self-service capabilities for platform users
* Supporting the introduction of new cloud, AI and analytics capabilities
* Helping to create a seamless developer and data practitioner experience across the platform ecosystem


**Location**
 Stockholm, Katowice, Amsterdam and Berlin
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Who are you?**
 You bring solid experience from cloud engineering environments and enjoy combining technology, security and automation to create reliable services for users. You are communicative, collaborative and enjoy working together with colleagues from different disciplines to solve complex challenges.
   

  

**We believe you have**
* Several years of experience as a Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer or similar role in Azure environments
* Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, preferably within operations, governance or platform engineering
* Strong understanding of Azure services including Networking, Storage, App Services, Virtual Machines and Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD practices
* Experience working with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as ARM, Bicep, Terraform and PowerShell
* Knowledge of analytics and data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark or modern data lake architectures
* Understanding of cloud governance, security and access management principles
* Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python or similar technologies
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities
* Professional communication skills in English (local language skills are a plus but not mandatory)


**It is an advantage if you also have**
* Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost optimisation
* Experience supporting enterprise AI or machine learning platforms


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our offer**
 A challenging and independent job in an informal, dynamic working environment. You can play a part in shaping the future of a company where the only constant is change. Besides being a challenging and inspiring place to work, we value a great work atmosphere!
   

  

 At Vattenfall, we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of gender, age, and ethnic and cultural backgrounds. We believe in work life balance and the flexibility to work from home.
   

  

**More Information**
**We welcome your application in English, no later than,** 
**24th of September 2026** 
 . We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.
   

  

 For more information about the role, please contact the
 **Hiring Manager Mansi Shamsingh Raghuwanshi** 
**: mansishamsingh.raghuwanshi@vattenfall.de** 
 for more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our
