title: Technical Success Manager- Nordics
description:
Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.
   

  

 Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.
   

  

 At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.
   

  

 We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.
   

  

 Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast
   

  

**Job Description:**
 The Technical Success Manager (TSM) is a high-impact customer-facing role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth, customer advocacy, and commercial awareness to help customers get lasting value from cybersecurity technology.
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with security, IT, and technical stakeholders to turn deployment into meaningful adoption, helping customers embed the platform into daily security operations, reduce risk, and achieve measurable outcomes.
   

  

 You will work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, and Renewals, bringing a clear technical view of customer health, adoption progress, risks, and renewal readiness.
   

  

 This is remote position from Copenhagen or Stockholm.
   

  

**What will I be doing:**
* Build trusted relationships with customer security and IT teams, understanding their priorities, workflows, and success outcomes.
* Create practical technical success plans that help customers adopt the platform, reduce risk, and realise measurable value.
* Identify high-value use cases that make the platform part of everyday security operations.
* Use product usage, engagement, and health indicators to spot adoption gaps, underutilisation, and retention risks early.
* Guide customers through the transition from deployment to active use, accelerating Time-to-Value and reducing handover friction.
* Lead mitigation planning for technical blockers, integration challenges, operational gaps, and customer health risks.
* Bring clear technical health insights into renewal readiness, QBRs, growth discussions, and account strategy.
* Surface technical opportunities that support expansion, upsell, and cross-sell activity in partnership with the Account Executive.
* Champion the voice of technical users by ensuring product feedback, risks, and success requirements are visible internally.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Customers are healthier, more engaged, and prepared for renewal and expansion.
* Technical risks are identified early and managed before they affect confidence or outcomes.
* Customers reach value faster after deployment or major use case activation.
* You are recognised by customers and account teams as a trusted, practical technical advisor.


**What experience do I need:**
* Fluency in Swedish or Danish and English is essential.
* You have 3+ years' experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as Customer Success Manager, Technical Success Manager, Technical Account Manager, Technical Consultant, Product Specialist, or similar.
* You understand enterprise cybersecurity, networking, cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments.
* You know how to drive adoption, retention, technical value realisation, and customer health improvement.
* You can translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for customers and internal teams.
* You are confident engaging with security engineers, SOC analysts, system administrators, technical leaders, and executives.
* You bring strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience with security operations, SOC workflows, threat detection, or incident response use cases is desirable.
* Familiarity with customer success platforms, health scoring, adoption analytics, and renewal governance is advantageous.


 This is an opportunity to sit at the centre of customer value, technical strategy, and retention, helping customers turn powerful cybersecurity technology into sustained operational impact.
   

  

 As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability.
   

  

*Darktrace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*
*Darktrace is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact your Talent Partner.*

title: Test Manager
description:
**About Cognizant**
 At Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH), we're in the business of making the future work — for our clients, our communities, and the people who build it alongside us. As a leading AI Builder and technology services company, we bring together a global team of 300,000+ associates across 50+ countries to help the world's biggest organizations modernize, innovate, and grow. We don't just talk about transformation; we engineer it, one complex challenge at a time. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to do your best work, explore more at cognizant.ai.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a pivotal leadership opportunity at the intersection of data engineering, quality assurance, and enterprise-scale transformation. As a
 **Test Manager** 
 , you will own the end-to-end testing strategy for ETL processes and Data Warehouse migration projects — most notably migrations from legacy on-premises environments to modern cloud platforms such as Snowflake. Operating within the banking domain, you will be the driving force ensuring data integrity, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout every phase of migration. This is not a back-office quality role — it is a strategic position where your decisions directly shape the reliability of mission-critical financial data.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 You will define and lead the overall test strategy, scope, and objectives across multiple concurrent migration projects, keeping everything aligned with Agile sprint cycles and release readiness gates. You set the quality bar — establishing KPIs, defect benchmarks, and test coverage targets — and then you hold the line on them.
   

  

 On a day-to-day basis, you serve as the connective tissue between QA engineers, developers, product owners, and business stakeholders across finance, compliance, and IT. You translate regulatory and business requirements into actionable test plans, then track progress with metrics that tell a real story: defect trends, test coverage gaps, and release readiness signals.
   

  

 You will lead ETL testing across banking data domains — customer data, transactions, and risk analytics — applying the right validation technique for each pipeline and data tier. You champion shift-left practices and continuous testing, proactively identifying automation opportunities that reduce regression cycles and integration testing overhead. Alongside this, you will manage synthetic test data generation and oversee test data environments in Snowflake, including UAT, to ensure secure and scalable testing conditions.
   

  

 Managing the human side of quality is equally important. You allocate resources, manage timelines, conduct risk assessments, and implement mitigation strategies when challenges arise. You facilitate planning sessions and stakeholder reporting, and you invest time in mentoring junior testers — building a team culture grounded in accountability, curiosity, and a genuine commitment to quality.
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

 You bring deep, hands-on experience in ETL testing — ideally with
 **IDMC (Informatica)** 
 — and you have navigated all phases of the project lifecycle: System Testing, UAT, Integration Testing, parallel runs, cutover, and BI reports testing. You know how to adapt your testing approach as a project evolves, and you understand what "done" truly looks like in a regulated banking environment.
   

  

 You have led or been a central contributor to at least one
 **end-to-end Data Warehouse migration project** 
 , preferably a Teradata-to-Snowflake migration, and you are familiar with the architectural nuances that make Snowflake different — including its separation of storage and compute. You are comfortable navigating audit readiness requirements and data governance policies, and you understand the compliance landscape well enough to keep testing aligned with banking regulations.
   

  

 Beyond the technical, you are a natural communicator and collaborator. You thrive in cross-functional environments, you manage change with clarity, and you know how to bring stakeholders along on the journey — from initial planning through to post-migration validation.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

**ETL & Data Tools:** 
 Informatica PowerCenter, IDMC, Snowflake (Time Travel, Cloning, Micro-partitions, Streams & Tasks)
   

  

**Cloud Platforms:** 
 Microsoft Azure (primary), with working knowledge of AWS and GCP; Snowflake integration experience across all three
   

  

**Data Warehousing:** 
 End-to-end DWH migration experience; strong understanding of on-premises to cloud migration patterns (Teradata to Snowflake preferred)
   

  

**SQL:** 
 Advanced proficiency — this is non-negotiable
   

  

**Scripting:** 
 Python, Shell, or PowerShell for automation of repeatable tasks and ETL validation workflows
   

  

**Testing Scope:** 
 Full lifecycle — System, UAT, Integration, parallel run & cutover, and BI/reporting layer testing
   

  

**Infrastructure:** 
 Experience with hybrid environments spanning on-premises, cloud, and big data platforms
   

  

*We're excited to meet people who share our passion for quality and can make a real impact in a high-stakes data environment. If you meet most but not all, of the requirements above, don't hesitate to apply. Your unique perspective and transferable experience may be exactly what we're looking for.*

title: FOUNDING PLATFORM ENGINEER
description:
**Who We Are**


We are a well-funded, early-stage technology company on a mission to fundamentally redefine the way the world searches, discovers, and transacts, built on a philosophy that puts the user first at every step.

  

The user is not simply a means of transaction. They are a valued participant whose data works for them, not against them, enriching their world and their own experience within it, with them retaining full control.

  

Our mission is underpinned by proprietary, patent-pending technology built on a novel engine and system.

**The Problem You Will Be Solving**


The internet was built to inform the many, not to serve the individual. Platforms optimize for engagement, extraction, and consumption at global scale. AI has made this model even more efficient, with the user still largely remaining the input, not the full beneficiary.

  

The problem is not information. The world has never had more. The problem is that people give away a lifetime of data without receiving the personalized experience it should enable.

  

People should not have to search. They should simply find.

**Who You Are**

* Highly talented and motivated to build products with people, for people
* You thrive in zero-to-one environments and find genuine satisfaction in creating from scratch
* A fast-paced thinker with a relentless desire to learn, improve, and raise the standard around you
* Able to inspire, elevate, and collaborate; you make the people around you better
* A great communicator; you express complex ideas with clarity, precision, and confidence across all levels of the organization
* Able to transform ideas into working systems and technical milestones with light speed and precision
* Highly ambitious and action-driven; you thrive under pressure and find genuine energy in working at the edge of what is considered possible
* Capable of designing and building production-grade systems in a fourth of the time most experienced and “sane” professionals would consider possible

**What You Will Do**

* Design and operate cloud infrastructure for large-scale consumer platforms with a strong focus on compute, networking, GPU resource management, and cost efficiency as a first-class engineering priority
* Build Kubernetes-based orchestration systems with deep understanding of resource scheduling, isolation boundaries, failure propagation, and operational reliability
* Build high-performance ML model serving infrastructure supporting concurrent model versions, canary and shadow deployments, and low-latency inference delivery within the performance and reliability constraints of a live consumer product
* Build CI/CD pipelines that give the team the deployment confidence and velocity of a dedicated platform engineering function
* Design data architecture with built-in classification, retention policies, access controls, and audit logging from day one
* Build comprehensive observability infrastructure including distributed tracing, model performance monitoring, cost tracking, and intelligent alerting for full production visibility

**Minimum Qualifications**

* MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a directly related field from KTH, Chalmers, or an institution of equivalent standing — or equivalent demonstrated production experience in lieu of formal qualification
* 2 or more years of experience originating and operating production infrastructure at meaningful scale; has designed systems that real products depend on, not maintained existing ones
* Kubernetes expertise below the configuration layer; real understanding of scheduler behavior, runtime characteristics, and resource contention
* Experience operating ML workloads in production; model versioning, inference scaling, and GPU resource management
* Infrastructure-as-code practice applied comprehensively and without exception

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GDPR obligations applied at the infrastructure and data architecture level
* Background from Spotify infrastructure, Ericsson cloud, King platform engineering, or Einride
* Demonstrated track record of provisioning production-grade infrastructure at a pace that sets a new reference point for teams around you
* 2–7 years of relevant experience

**What We Offer**


Expect the most talented, rigorous, and driven colleagues you have worked with; people who lift each other up and hold each other to the highest standard. This company is driven by ideas and innovation, regardless of age, position, or background. The best ideas must win and the people behind them recognized and rewarded.

  

A home for exceptional people and geniuses within their domain; those who have always known what they are capable of and have been waiting for the environment to prove it to the world, whilst first being seen and supported by their coworkers.

  

Compensation includes an attractive salary and meaningful equity ownership for an early-stage startup.

**Equal Opportunity**


We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work and reach their full potential. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Application**


To apply, send your CV/resume, GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on how and why you would like to contribute to our mission. Upon initial acceptance, an in-person interview will follow shortly in Stockholm, Sweden.

  

Please note that all applications and interviews are conducted in English. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement for all roles.

  

All applications are treated with strict confidentiality.

title: Team Lead - Systems Engineering
description:
* Permanent
* Experienced Professionals
* Products & Systems Engineering
* ID 543578-en\_US
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Your role**
  

We are looking for a Consultant and Team Lead to our Product & Systems Engineering unit. You will work with System Engineering and requirements on Product & Systems, both in SW & HW domain. Often Model Based Engineering including to follow Functional Safety and Cybers Security standards. You will also work within electrical and electronics on product & System level, for example as electrical or electronics engineer within power supply, electrical machines & battery systems. The role will be a combination of team responsibility and being a consultant in our delivery.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*


* Recruit new team members and support, develop and mentor the members in the team
* Support the Engineering Unit Manager with recruitment, business growth, retention etc.
* Manage and support career development for your team
* Contribute to technical solutions/sales activities of new projects
* Work on technical customer proposals
* Be part of technical delivery/assignment to our clients

**Your profile**


* A degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Mechatronics, Engineering or similar
* 5-8 years of experience as an advanced System Engineer, Technical lead, or similar
* Experience as Team Lead, Scrum Master, Project Manager or similar is advantageous
* Fluency in English, and preferably in Swedish language

**What we believe you will enjoy about working here**

* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
* At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
* We support your personal development and offer an education library with more than 250 000 (!) courses and educations and certifications.

**Application**
  

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification or background checks may occasionally be conducted.


Valid work permit for Sweden is required.
  

#LI-Onsite


Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.
company_description: Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value.

title: Vi söker en Head Chef till Scandic Anglais, heltid
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 1 oktober 2026
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Scandic Anglais är hotellet som ligger mitt i stadspulsen på Stureplan!

Scandic Anglais ligger mitt i centrala Stockholm, intill det pulserande Stureplan och den grönskande Humlegården. I kvarteren runt hotellet finns Stockholms bästa shoppingstråk och centrum av Stockholms uteliv. Hos oss kan gäster njuta av Stureplanspulsen i vår populära Bar Anglais, där laptopjobb varvas med klassiska barrätter och stimmiga afterworks. Under sommaren kan våra gäster även besöka vår takbar med utsikt över takåsarna och Humlegårdens grönska.

Scandic Anglais har nyligen genomgått en omfattande renovering där hotellrum, bar, restaurang, kök och frukostkoncept har fått ett helt nytt uttryck. Med våra nyrenoverade miljöer och ett utvecklat mat- och dryckeserbjudande har vi höga ambitioner och förväntningar på att skapa en gästupplevelse i absolut toppklass. Vi befinner oss i en spännande utvecklingsfas där vi fortsätter att stärka vår position som en självklar destination för både Stockholmare och besökare. För att lyckas med det söker vi medarbetare som delar vår passion för service och som vill vara med och skapa minnesvärda upplevelser för varje gäst, varje dag.
Kännetecknande för arbetet på Scandic Anglais är den familjära stämningen och passionen för god service. Tillsammans strävar vi efter att fortsatt vara en destination för såväl Stockholmare som tillresande och att ge våra gäster service i absolut toppklass. Så nu söker vi dig som tillsammans med oss vill ge våra gäster service utöver det vanliga!

Vi söker en Head Chef till Scandic Anglais.
På Scandic arbetar alla tillsammans för att skapa en gästupplevelse i världsklass under gästens hela vistelse. Som Head Chef är du den som motiverar, driver, utvecklar och engagerar alla i teamet att ta ett stort eget ansvar för att förbättra arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens, som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar och vi får även väldigt roligt på jobbet!
Vad innebär rollen?
Du har det övergripande ansvaret för köksdriften inom Frukost, Meeting & Event samt Restaurang. Tillsammans med ditt team säkerställer du att all matproduktion håller högsta kvalitet och bidrar till en gästupplevelse i världsklass. Du ansvarar för att verksamheten bedrivs effektivt, lönsamt och med gästen i fokus, samtidigt som du säkerställer hög kvalitet, god service och ett erbjudande som möter gästernas behov.

Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta med HACCP, Opera Cloud, FireSafe och Quinyx.
Du leder och utvecklar verksamheten och medarbetarna utifrån företagets strategi, mål och lokala förutsättningar. Du har en passion för service och genom ditt ledarskap inspirerar och motiverar du dina medarbetare samt skapar förutsättningar för att ni tillsammans ska skapa enastående gästupplevelser. Som Head Chef är du även en del av den dagliga driften och du ansvarar för att planera och bemanna utifrån verksamhetens behov. Du ingår i hotellets ledningsgrupp vilket innebär att du tillsammans med dina kollegor har ett övergripande ansvar för hela hotellet.
Vem är du?
Du ser positivt på förändringar och har förmågan att leda andra genom dem, är flexibel och har lätt att se lösningar och att skapa relationer. Du är en ledare, som ser det som självklart att vara närvarande på olika tider och dagar samt har ett helhetsperspektiv i allt du gör. Du ser till nyttan av samarbete, att ge regelbunden feedback och är kommunikativ i din ledarstil. Du planerar din tid och jobbar målmedvetet mot kort- och långsiktiga mål. Som chef hos oss lever du efter vår ledarskapskompass med Inspire, Collaborate, Build trust och Empower som en naturlig del av ditt ledarskap. Du lever våra värderingar och agerar som ett föredöme i din roll.
Du har tidigare erfarenhet från att leda andra i en liknande roll samt relevant utbildning och erfarenhet inom servicebranschen. Du har god administrativ förmåga, erfarenhet av ekonomisk planering och uppföljning samt god vana att arbeta i olika systemstöd. Du behöver dessutom ha goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Information om tjänsten:
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid.
Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av personlighetstester som del av urvalet.
Ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!

title: Receptionist Scandic Kalmar Väst, deltid 55%
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 20 september 2026
* Kalmar
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Beläget invid E22 ligger Scandic Kalmar Väst, nära både till flygplatsen och centrala Kalmar. Hotellet erbjuder en välkomnade och gemytlig miljö- ett ställe där man vill vara både som gäst och medarbetare.


Vi som jobbar här fokuserar på ett personligt, trevligt och välkomnande bemötande mot våra gäster så klart, men också mot varandra. Vi har alltid fokus på vårt gemensamma arbete och sluter upp tillsammans där det behövs. Genom att vara ett team som jobbar med mycket inspiration och glädje skapar vi fantastiska hotellupplevelser för våra gäster



**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Kalmar Väst.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**



Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**



För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.



Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Har du jobbat inom reception eller besöksnäringen tidigare är det ett stort plus, men inget krav.



Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**



Tjänsten avser ett föräldravikariat på drygt ett år. Tjänstgöringsgrad 55%.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt.


Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!



Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Sr. Engineer Systems & AI - Core
description:
Hos TV4 möts teknik, innovation, nyhetsjournalistik, sport och underhållning.


Vi bygger Nordens största streamingtjänst som i snitt når cirka åtta miljoner nordbor i veckan genom TV4 Play och vår finska motsvarighet MTV Katsomo. Inom Product, Tech & Operations utvecklar vi de tekniska lösningar som bland annat gör det möjligt att streama innehåll, söka och få rekommendationer, så att människor kan ta del av allt vårt innehåll när och var de vill.


Nu söker vi en **Sr Engineer Systems & AI** till Core med ett brett tekniskt uppdrag. Du kommer att arbeta tvärs över team och system med komplexa tekniska utmaningar, från att förstå helheten och sätta riktning till att bidra hands-on i lösningen.

**Om Core**
-----------


Core bygger och förvaltar flera av de tekniska lösningar och plattformar som TV4 Play och MTV Katsomo är beroende av. Området består idag av Engineering Platform, Nexus, Streaming Delivery och Streaming Experience Player. Arbetet sker nära andra produktområden och både utmaningar och lösningar sträcker sig ofta över flera system och team.


Rollen är därför inte knuten till ett specifikt team. Du rapporterar till Area Lead för Core och arbetar där din tekniska erfarenhet kan göra störst skillnad.

**Vad du kommer att göra**
--------------------------


Du kommer framför allt att ta dig an komplexa tekniska utmaningar där vägen framåt inte är given. Det kan handla om beroenden mellan flera system, svåra integrationer, arkitekturbeslut som påverkar flera team eller tekniska frågor där det saknas ett självklart vägval.


Du behöver snabbt kunna sätta dig in i nya tekniska sammanhang, se samband mellan systemen och gå på djupet där det behövs. Det innebär också att tidigt kunna se risker och beroenden och förstå vad som behöver redas ut innan ni går vidare.


Du kommer bland annat att:

* Ta tekniskt ansvar från analys och vägval till implementation när situationen kräver det
* Driva tekniska beslut tillsammans med de team och personer som berörs
* Vara hands-on och använda kod, prototyper och tekniska experiment för att förstå, testa och lösa utmaningar
* Dela kunskap, skapa tydlighet och bidra till att bättre tekniska beslut fattas

**AI förändrar hur vi bygger**
------------------------------


AI är redan en integrerad del av hur vi utvecklar mjukvara på TV4. Inom Core bygger vi nu en agentisk plattform som kommer att påverka hur våra utvecklare arbetar och hur vi organiserar utveckling framåt.


I den här rollen kommer du att vara nära den utvecklingen. Vi söker dig som redan experimenterar aktivt med agentdriven utveckling och nya verktyg, men framför allt vill utforska vad de innebär för arkitektur, utvecklingsprocesser och engineering i praktiken.


Du kommer både att använda och utvärdera nya arbetssätt och hjälpa oss förstå vilka förändringar som faktiskt skapar värde i produktion.

**Om dig**
----------


Du är en erfaren utvecklare med bred teknisk grund och har byggt och tagit ansvar för system i produktion. Du trivs med att röra dig mellan olika delar av en teknisk miljö och är van vid att sätta dig in i sådant du inte arbetat med tidigare.


Du tycker om tekniska utmaningar där svaret inte är givet. Du kan bilda dig en egen uppfattning, samtidigt som du söker perspektiv från andra och ändrar dig när ny information visar en bättre väg.


Vi tror också att du:

* Har erfarenhet av arkitektur och systemdesign och förstår hur tekniska beslut påverkar mer än systemet du arbetar i för stunden
* Har arbetat med distribuerade system, cloud/infrastruktur eller utveckling av större applikationer. Erfarenhet av streaming, playback eller AV är meriterande
* Fortfarande tycker om att arbeta nära tekniken och går gärna till kod eller prototyp när det är det bästa sättet att förstå eller testa något
* Är nyfiken och lär dig snabbt, även när du rör dig utanför områden där du redan är expert
* Kan föra tekniska resonemang på djupet och anpassa kommunikationen efter sammanhang och mottagare
* Har integrerat AI i ditt sätt att arbeta och aktivt utforskar agentdriven utveckling och hur den förändrar modern software engineering

**Teknisk miljö**
-----------------


Core spänner över ett brett tekniskt landskap. Här finns allt från backendtjänster, API:er och utvecklarplattformar till videouppspelning och infrastrukturen som levererar våra strömmar till miljontals användare.


Beroende på var du arbetar kommer du bland annat att möta:

* **Backend och systemutveckling:** Go, Rust, Node.js och TypeScript
* **Cloud och infrastruktur:** AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform och GitHub Actions
* **Data och observability:** PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Grafana och OpenTelemetry
* **Video och streaming:** transkodering och paketering, ABR, CDN, SSAI, DRM, codecs och streaming reliability
* **AI och utvecklarverktyg:** Claude Code, OpenAI Codex och CLI/MCP-baserade verktyg


Vi väljer teknik utifrån vad vi ska lösa. För den här rollen är därför förståelse för system och arkitektur viktigare än djup specialistkompetens i en specifik stack.

### **Vad TV4 erbjuder dig**

* Kort väg från idé till beslut i en senior teknikorganisation med hög autonomi för både team och individ
* Möjlighet att påverka hur vi bygger mjukvara och tekniska plattformar för miljontals användare
* En kultur som värdesätter hållbara tekniska lösningar framför snabba genvägar
* Kollegor med hög teknisk kompetens och stort ägandeskap
* Modernt kontor med gym, restaurang, garage och takterrass
* Kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar, friskvårdsbidrag, Benify, valfri telefon och MacBook Pro

### **Praktisk information**


TV4 är office-first och vi arbetar från kontoret fyra dagar i veckan.


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.


Facklig tillhörighet: Unionen.


Bakgrundskontroll ingår i processen.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Change and Release Manager
description:
Change Manager / Release Manager | Data Platform Modernisation About Cognizant
  
**Cognizant (Nasdaq:** CTSH) is one of the world's leading AI-builders and technology services companies, helping businesses across industries reimagine their operations and accelerate their digital futures. With more than 300,000 associates operating across 50+ countries, we combine deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver real, lasting impact. We are a place where bold thinking meets purposeful execution — and where your career can grow alongside the work you do. To learn more about who we are and where we're headed, visit cognizant.ai. About the Role
  
This is a pivotal dual-mandate role sitting at the intersection of people change and technical release governance. As a Change Manager / Release Manager, you will take ownership of end-to-end change enablement and release execution for a large-scale data platform modernisation programme — one that is transforming how the enterprise manages, processes and delivers data at scale. The programme centres on migrating the enterprise data warehouse from Teradata to Snowflake and transitioning ETL workloads from Informatica PowerCenter to Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) and DBT. Your mission is to ensure that every release reaches production in a controlled, well-communicated and minimally disruptive way, while simultaneously ensuring that every stakeholder — from data producers to reporting teams to operations — is ready, equipped and confident to thrive in the new world. You will operate as a trusted cross-functional leader, collaborating with business, engineering, architecture, testing, security, infrastructure, operations and vendor teams to drive stakeholder readiness, deployment quality, cutover execution, adoption and long-term operational stability. What You'll Do
  
On the change management side, you will develop and execute the programme change strategy, roadmap and integrated change plan — aligned to migration waves, testing cycles, releases, hypercare and decommissioning. You will conduct stakeholder, impact and readiness assessments across data producers, consumers, application owners, reporting teams and control functions, translating complex technical changes into clear operational impacts. From there, you will design and deliver targeted communication, training and adoption plans, coordinate UAT readiness and business-user enablement, manage BAU handovers, and track change risks and adoption gaps — escalating concerns before they become blockers. You will maintain the full suite of change artefacts throughout the programme lifecycle: stakeholder maps, impact assessments, communication calendars, training plans, readiness dashboards and a lessons-learned register.
  
On the release management side, you will define and govern the end-to-end release lifecycle per migration wave — from planning and build coordination through testing, deployment and post-release hypercare. You will own the cutover playbook, orchestrate dry runs and go-live execution, and facilitate CAB governance, ensuring every deployment is backed by validated checklists, rollback procedures and contingency plans. You will manage the post-release stabilisation period, monitor production health, coordinate hypercare support and maintain the programme release schedule, risk register, dependency log and governance reporting. What We're Looking For
  
You bring significant experience — typically seven or more years — in change management and release management within large-scale enterprise data or platform transformation programmes. You are equally comfortable navigating the human side of change and the technical mechanics of release governance, and you understand intuitively how the two disciplines reinforce each other. You have worked in environments where the stakes are high, the stakeholder landscape is complex, and the pace is demanding — and you have consistently delivered structure, clarity and momentum in those conditions.
  
You are well-versed in structured change management methodologies such as Prosci ADKAR or Kotter's model, and you have applied ITIL-aligned release and change management processes in real-world enterprise settings. You thrive in Agile and SAFe delivery environments and are comfortable operating across both waterfall and iterative programme structures. Your communication and stakeholder engagement skills are exceptional — you know how to read a room, adapt your message and bring people on a journey, whether you are presenting to a programme steering committee or running an enablement session with end users. You bring strong facilitation, documentation and reporting skills, and you take genuine pride in the quality and clarity of the artefacts you produce. Experience in data platform migrations — particularly involving Snowflake, Teradata, Informatica or DBT — will give you a meaningful head start in this role, as will familiarity with enterprise data warehousing concepts, ETL pipelines and data governance principles. Technical Skills
  
**Data Platforms:** Snowflake, Teradata, understanding of cloud-native data warehouse architecture and migration patterns
  
**ETL & Data Integration:** Informatica PowerCenter, Informatica IDMC (Intelligent Data Management Cloud), DBT, experience with pipeline governance and transition planning
  
**Change Management Frameworks:** Prosci ADKAR, Kotter's 8-Step Model, practical application in enterprise transformation programmes
  
**Release & ITSM Tooling:** ServiceNow (Change Management module), JIRA, Confluence, release tracking, CAB management and documentation
  
**Delivery Frameworks:** Agile, SAFe, Waterfall — comfortable operating in hybrid programme environments
  
**Collaboration & Reporting:** Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Power BI or equivalent, stakeholder dashboards, readiness reporting and communication management
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Cognizant is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you require an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: Consulting Clinician - MADRS Clinical Rater (Swedish Fluency)
description:
**About Cogstate**
------------------


At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.


Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.


Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.


At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

**About the Clinician Network**
-------------------------------


By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.  

  

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.


Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.  

  

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our **monthly Clinician Network newsletter**, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

**About the Role**
------------------


Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.


Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

* These are contract position.
* They are fully remote.
* Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

  

* **MADRS Administration Experience Required**
* **Swedish Fluency Required**

  

**Key Responsibilities**
Central Rating

* Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
* Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
* Scoring completed scale administrations.
* Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.


Central Monitoring

* Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
* Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

**Qualifications & Expertise**

* **MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)**
* **Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment**
* **Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings**
* **Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations**
* **Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery**
* **Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.**
* **Swedish** **Fluency**
* **MADRS Administration Experience Required**

 **Our Culture**  

We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.


If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!


Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the company. If you need assistance in applying please email PeopleandCulture@cogstate.com.

**Privacy Notice for Job Applicants**


Cogstate is committed to protecting your personal data. We collect and process your information for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), and similar laws in other jurisdictions.


For more information on how we collect, use, and protect your data, and your rights under these laws, you can find Cogstate's privacy policy by clicking here.

What you'll be doing:

title: Service Delivery Lead – Cybersecurity och Identity Services
description:
Som Service Delivery Lead för Cybersecurity & Identity Services ansvarar du för våra leveranser inom cybersäkerhet och identitetstjänster inkluderat IAM. Du är den interna ägaren av våra tjänster inom cybersäkerhet och identitetshantering och fungerar som huvudsaklig kontaktpunkt gentemot vår leverantör av managerade tjänster.
  
I denna roll arbetar du nära interna intressenter, IT-ledningen och externa partners för att säkerställa tillförlitliga, robusta och regelmässiga säkerhetstjänster som gör det möjligt för verksamheten att bedriva sin verksamhet på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
  
En viktig del av rollen är att ha en stark förmåga att beställa, styra, följa upp och förvalta outsourcade cybersäkerhetstjänster. Detta inkluderar att säkerställa kostnadseffektivitet, transparens samt att tjänsterna är i linje med företagets strategi och mål.
  
Det börjar med dig!
  
  

**I rollen som Service Delivery Lead kommer du att:**  

Äga och följa upp tjänsteleveranser inom Cybersäkerhet, Identitet och IAM.
  
Leda forum och möten för att följa upp och förbättra leveranser av IT-tjänster relativt säkerhet och compliance.
  
Forma och förverkliga vår cybersäkerhetsstrategi tillsammans med övriga organisationen. Du identifierar, bedömer och prioriterar risker, samt implementerar åtgärder som matchar både verksamhetens mål och gällande regelverk.
  
Övervaka hanteringen av säkerhetsincidenter och sårbarheter. Vid kritiska säkerhetsincidenter är det du som säkrar effektiv kommunikation, samordning och uppföljning.
  
Säkerställa att vi alltid ligger i linje med säkerhetspolicyer, arkitekturstandarder och regulatoriska krav inom cybersäkerhet.
  
Godkänna och koordinera förändringar från vår driftleverantör (MSP) för att garantera minimal affärspåverkan.
  
Knyta samman arbetet med Identitet och Säkerhet med IT-drift, plattformsägare, arkitekter och ledningsgrupp.
  
Tillsammans med ditt team översätta säkerhetsbehov till krav på tjänster och kommunicera risker på ett självklart sätt.
  
Tillsammans med ditt team stötta funktioner som kvalitet, risk och internkontroll kring tolkning och uppföljning av krav på cybersäkerhet, direktiv, standarder och kontroller som ligger inom området för cybersäkerhet.
  
  

Din passion för IT och verksamhet
  
Du är en trygg och inkluderande ledare som tar ett ägandeskap och får saker att hända. Din nyfikenhet och förmåga att skapa engagemang gör att du trivs i en roll där du har många kontaktytor. Du kommunicerar effektivt med både IT och interna kunder inom vår verksamhet.
  
  

**Vi ser också att du har:**  

God förståelse för cybersäkerhetsområdet (on-prem och cloud) och IAM såsom Identity and Access Management (IAM), SOC/SIEM, sårbarhetshantering och hantering av säkerhetsincidenter.
  
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med leverantörer av managerade säkerhetstjänster (Managed Security Service Providers, MSSP).
  
God kunskap om hur en IT-avdelning fungerar exempelvis Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management och Service Level Management.
  
Förståelse för molntjänster såsom Azure AD / Entra ID, Microsoft 365, AWS med flera, samt moderna identitets- och säkerhetsarkitekturer såsom Zero Trust, Conditional Access, multifaktorautentisering (MFA) och hantering konton med höga privilegier.
  
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med säkerhetsramverk och ledningssystem som NIST, ISO 27001 och CIS Critical Security Controls, samt kunskap om regulatoriska krav inom cybersäkerhet på verksamheter inom EU.
  
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med leverantörer och tjänsteleverantörer.
  
Flytande engelska samt goda kunskaper i svenska.
  
  

Utöver detta tror vi att du har en akademisk examen och minst fem års erfarenhet från en liknande roll. Du trivs med en kombination av strategiska och operativa arbetsuppgifter
  
  

Låter detta intressant? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning och gör bakgrundskontroll. Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

title: Test Manager
description:
About Cognizant
  
**At Cognizant (Nasdaq:** CTSH), we're in the business of making the future work — for our clients, our communities, and the people who build it alongside us. As a leading AI Builder and technology services company, we bring together a global team of 300,000+ associates across 50+ countries to help the world's biggest organizations modernize, innovate, and grow. We don't just talk about transformation; we engineer it, one complex challenge at a time. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to do your best work, explore more at cognizant.ai. About the Role
  
This is a pivotal leadership opportunity at the intersection of data engineering, quality assurance, and enterprise-scale transformation. As a Test Manager , you will own the end-to-end testing strategy for ETL processes and Data Warehouse migration projects — most notably migrations from legacy on-premises environments to modern cloud platforms such as Snowflake. Operating within the banking domain, you will be the driving force ensuring data integrity, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout every phase of migration. This is not a back-office quality role — it is a strategic position where your decisions directly shape the reliability of mission-critical financial data. What You'll Do
  
You will define and lead the overall test strategy, scope, and objectives across multiple concurrent migration projects, keeping everything aligned with Agile sprint cycles and release readiness gates. You set the quality bar — establishing KPIs, defect benchmarks, and test coverage targets — and then you hold the line on them.
  
On a day-to-day basis, you serve as the connective tissue between QA engineers, developers, product owners, and business stakeholders across finance, compliance, and IT. You translate regulatory and business requirements into actionable test plans, then track progress with metrics that tell a real story: defect trends, test coverage gaps, and release readiness signals.
  
You will lead ETL testing across banking data domains — customer data, transactions, and risk analytics — applying the right validation technique for each pipeline and data tier. You champion shift-left practices and continuous testing, proactively identifying automation opportunities that reduce regression cycles and integration testing overhead. Alongside this, you will manage synthetic test data generation and oversee test data environments in Snowflake, including UAT, to ensure secure and scalable testing conditions.
  
Managing the human side of quality is equally important. You allocate resources, manage timelines, conduct risk assessments, and implement mitigation strategies when challenges arise. You facilitate planning sessions and stakeholder reporting, and you invest time in mentoring junior testers — building a team culture grounded in accountability, curiosity, and a genuine commitment to quality. What We're Looking For
  
You bring deep, hands-on experience in ETL testing — ideally with IDMC (Informatica) — and you have navigated all phases of the project lifecycle: System Testing, UAT, Integration Testing, parallel runs, cutover, and BI reports testing. You know how to adapt your testing approach as a project evolves, and you understand what "done" truly looks like in a regulated banking environment.
  
You have led or been a central contributor to at least one end-to-end Data Warehouse migration project , preferably a Teradata-to-Snowflake migration, and you are familiar with the architectural nuances that make Snowflake different — including its separation of storage and compute. You are comfortable navigating audit readiness requirements and data governance policies, and you understand the compliance landscape well enough to keep testing aligned with banking regulations.
  
Beyond the technical, you are a natural communicator and collaborator. You thrive in cross-functional environments, you manage change with clarity, and you know how to bring stakeholders along on the journey — from initial planning through to post-migration validation. Technical Skills
  
**ETL & Data Tools:** Informatica PowerCenter, IDMC, Snowflake (Time Travel, Cloning, Micro-partitions, Streams & Tasks)
  
**Cloud Platforms:** Microsoft Azure (primary), with working knowledge of AWS and GCP; Snowflake integration experience across all three
  
**Data Warehousing:** End-to-end DWH migration experience; strong understanding of on-premises to cloud migration patterns (Teradata to Snowflake preferred)
  
**SQL:** Advanced proficiency — this is non-negotiable
  
**Scripting:** Python, Shell, or PowerShell for automation of repeatable tasks and ETL validation workflows
  
**Testing Scope:** Full lifecycle — System, UAT, Integration, parallel run & cutover, and BI/reporting layer testing
  
**Infrastructure:** Experience with hybrid environments spanning on-premises, cloud, and big data platforms
  
We're excited to meet people who share our passion for quality and can make a real impact in a high-stakes data environment. If you meet most but not all, of the requirements above, don't hesitate to apply. Your unique perspective and transferable experience may be exactly what we're looking for.

title: (Senior) Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
### **Company**


NestAI is a European AI lab for defence delivering the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. We develop adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions.


NestOS is our open, modular, and interoperable platform that enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI brings together over 150 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry.

### **Role Description**


We are looking for a **Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** to join our team full-time in Stockholm, or with the ability to commute to Stockholm metropolitan area around 3 days per week.


As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing eiher in **Artificial Intelligence, Embedded Systems or Full Stack Engineering**, you manage the technical delivery and integration of NestAI’s autonomous systems for our partners. Embedded directly within key partner initiatives, FDE squads shorten the path from development to fielded capability, validating product features where assumptions are tested against operational reality.


This is not a standard implementation role; it is a high-stakes engineering position where you tailor our platforms to the complex, real-world environments of our most critical partners. We are looking for a senior builder who understands that in mission-critical domains, "good enough" doesn't exist. You will bring a high degree of architectural depth to solve problems where software meets hardware in the physical world.

**Day-to-day responsibilities include:**

* **Mission-Specific Engineering:** Technical leadership for client projects, taking full ownership of technical decisions to rapidly deploy and customize our platforms to specific client needs.
* **Architectural Integration:** Design, develop, and deploy solutions that connect edge devices, UAV sensors, and situational intelligence platforms into a cohesive operational picture supporting customer operating environments.
* **AI-Driven Development:** Utilize AI-driven development workflows to accelerate delivery cycles with our platforms without compromising the sovereign and reliable core of our systems.
* **Collaborative Problem Solving:** Work closely with client technical teams and internal product R&D to translate complex field requirements into scalable product features. Create rapid prototypes to explore future client aspirations.
* **Technical Leadership:** Act as the primary technical point of contact for customer engagements, providing the architectural "glue" between disparate data sources and decision-support interfaces.

### **Qualifications**

* **Generalist Mindset & Adaptability:** A versatile generalist profile; you enjoy changing scenery, adapt quickly to unfamiliar codebases, and feel comfortable operating across diverse technical ecosystems.
* A deep technical foundation and 5+ years of experience in at least one of the following: **Cloud, AI, Edge/Embedded Computing, Machine Learning, or Data Engineering**.
* A proven ability to think in "spatial" terms—understanding how AI interacts with physical environments and complex hardware architectures.
* You communicate fluently both in English and Swedish. You also have excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to confidently collaborate with external partners, translate business/operational needs into engineering reality, and lead client-facing deployments.
* Mindset: You thrive in "mission-first" environments and possess the Nordic engineering ethos of building systems that earn trust through performance, not promises.
* Ability to travel occasionally (up to 10% of worktime) to client sites within Europe to ensure field-proven performance.
* **Pluses:** Previous consulting or customer-facing engineering experience. Prior background in defence, aerospace, robotics, or related physical AI domains.

### **Why join NestAI**


At NestAI, you’ll build meaningful, real-world technology as part of a world-class team of engineers, scientists, and experienced professionals. You’ll work on systems where reliability genuinely matters, contribute to Europe’s security and resilience, and solve problems that demand depth, trust, and craftsmanship.


If you want to build with purpose — and with leading experts in the field — you’ve come to the right place.

### **Practicalities**


Employment is subject to applicable security screening.


NestAI is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential.


We are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship or international relocation support for this position. Candidates must already be based in Sweden or in the EU and have a valid work permit for this region at the time of application.

title: Global field operations field engineer, EMEA GFO Eng team
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


EMEA GFO is seeking a passionate, results oriented engineer to drive operational excellence in its colocation based data center operations. This position serves as a technical resource to support Amazon Web Services (AWS) within its geographically distributed Global field operations. The position will drive overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed the defined service level expectations of data center operations.  

  

The Global field engineer will be responsible for working with Biz development on site qualification and selection. In addition the engineer will be responsible for working with the Colo providers to oversee the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, and HVAC equipment in multiple colocation data centers. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and networking equipment with high uptime expectations. The Global Field Engineer will identify and drive projects to maintain high reliability and performance while keeping operating costs in facilities at a minimum. Where appropriate, the engineer will drive innovation cooperatively with the colocation facility to reduce operational costs. A strong sense of ownership will be demonstrated for this position.  

  

The Global Field Engineer is Amazon’s front line technical subject matter leader when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment operations and troubleshooting. They will work with the Colo provider and Biz Development to ensure the ongoing maintenance and operations of Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.  

  

\*Please note that this role will require up to 60% travel around the EMEA area\*  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Supervise, advise and collab with Colocation operators performing servicing or preventive maintenance.
* Assist in performing root cause analysis for operational issues.
* Perform periodic on site reviews and audits of operations, electrical, and mechanical systems
* Supervise the design and implementation of retrofits of existing facilities
* Qualify new sites for new deployments
* Drive operational excellence in all data center sites
* Perform first level trouble-shooting for facility and rack level events.
* Approval of all CMs (Change Management Tasks) to enable changes and maintenance at sites.
* Attending weekly calls with both TPMs and CAD designers, designing and retrofitting new and existing cages within our EMEA edge space.

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* This role requires that you are a citizen of an EU member state.
* Successfully completed relevant technical training with over 5 years of extensive practical experience as a Data Center Engineer (Responsible Electrical Specialist), as well as an additional qualification as a Technician or Industrial Master Craftsman.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with change management systems.
* Many years of experience with the operation and maintenance of electrical building systems (power distribution, lighting, grounding, fire alarm, security, personal safety, and control systems).
* University degree in Electrical Engineering.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Fungera som ämnesexpert som stödjer flera team eller som teknisk teamledare med övergripande ansvar för leveransen.


**För att lyckas med detta tror vi att du:**

* Utmärkta kommunikationsfärdigheter på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

**Kvalifikationer och färdigheter:**

* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code (ARM, Bicep, Terraform etc.).
* Förståelse och erfarenhet av ramverk som Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Security Adoption Framework samt Well-Architected Framework
* Kunskap inom molnsäkerhet och Zero Trust arkitektur.
* Kunskap och erfarenhet av containerlösningar som Docker och Kubernetes är meriterande.


**Om Sopra Steria:**
 Sopra Steria är en global aktör inom digital transformation med över 50 000 medarbetare i över 30 länder, varav 600 i Sverige. Vi har blivit rankade som en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser 2025 av Great Place to Work och är ett av topp fem bolag inom Digital Transformation enligt Gartner. Vi erbjuder en inkluderande och skicklig arbetsmiljö där du har möjlighet att vässa dina kunskaper och arbeta med branschens mest spännande projekt. Vi står nu inför en spännande tillväxtresa som genomsyrar hela verksamheten där det finns stora möjligheter att växa tillsammans med bolaget och skapa verklig förändring genom digital utveckling.
