title: Software Engineer - Engineering Productivity / AI
description:
**We're looking for software engineers to grow our team Agents. You are a star with us if you have gone through the journey of product -> platform -> AI. This is us. Interested?** 




  





*AI is changing how software gets built. At Nordnet, engineers are already working with AI agents daily - and the bottlenecks are shifting. Code gets written faster, but reviews pile up. Workflows accelerate, but orchestration lags behind.* 




  





*The Agents team exists to solve this. We're a platform team responsible for scaling AI adoption and AI productivity across Nordnet by building agentic workflows and orchestration into the software development lifecycle. Right now, we're building an automated agentic code review process — our first step toward removing the review bottleneck that emerged as engineers started working more agentically.* 




  





*We're looking for engineers who want to work at the intersection of developer tooling and AI. If you're excited about designing systems that make hundreds of engineers measurably more productive, this is the role.* 




  





**What you will do** 




 In this role, you'll work across the engineering organisation to:
 


* Design and build agentic workflows that automate and accelerate parts of the SDLC
* Develop the tooling and orchestration layer for AI-assisted code review, testing, and delivery
* Identify bottlenecks in developer workflows and build AI-powered solutions to remove them
* Maintain and evolve our internal developer portal and shared tooling
* Create data-driven insights that help teams understand and improve their engineering practices
* Collaborate closely with product and platform teams to drive adoption of new tools and workflows



 This is hands-on engineering work with high organizational impact. You'll ship things that change how the entire company builds software.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 You are an engineer with a strong software development background who:
 


* Has built production systems and understands what makes them reliable
* Is curious about AI, LLMs, and agentic patterns — and wants to apply them to real problems
* Cares about developer experience and thinks in terms of reducing friction at scale
* Communicates clearly and enjoys working across teams to find pragmatic solutions
* Is comfortable navigating ambiguity — this is a fast-moving space and we're charting new territory.



 We don't expect you to tick every box. If your experience is adjacent and you're excited about building AI-powered developer tooling, we encourage you to apply.
 



  





**We value engineers who** 



* Are pragmatic and collaborative
* Are comfortable giving and receiving feedback
* Care about simplicity and measurable outcomes over complexity
* Enjoy working closely with their internal customers
* Take a scientific approach — experiment, measure, iterate



  





**Experience that will help you succeed** 



* TypeScript, Java, or Golang
* Cloud platforms (GCP preferred) and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
* CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling
* Working with LLMs, AI APIs, or building agentic systems
* Data analysis and visualisation (BigQuery, VertexAI, or similar)
* Containerisation and orchestration (Kubernetes)



  





**We offer** 



* A collaborative environment where learning is continuous
* Meaningful technical challenges to tackle together with experienced colleagues
* A front-row seat to how AI is reshaping software engineering — and the chance to drive it
* Opportunities to grow as an engineer and/or leader
* Competitive salary and compensation



  





**Who we are** 




 Nordnet started from a passionate belief that changing the hierarchical financial world was possible. We became part of redefining the industry when we gave the customers power over their own savings. You will become part of a journey that has only yet started towards the vision of making our customers the best investors they can be. To be leading in IT is pivotal for that journey and you will work with colleagues who have a great passion for that goal.
 



 We are 1000+ employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki and Copenhagen. We cooperate, exchange ideas and use our core competencies in order to continuously improve the way we meet our customers. Open communication, creativity and engagement are important parts of our everyday life at the office.
 



  





 Culture is built and cared for, each day by everyone. We're proud of ours. Having a flat organization where anyone can talk to anyone creates a warm and friendly atmosphere worth protecting. We believe in a culture where every effort counts and where everyone is being recognized. A culture embracing our core values – passion, simplicity and transparency on all levels, no matter who you are or what you do.
 



  





 Visit us on www.nordnetab.com, www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk and www.nordnet.fi.
 



  





**Application** 




 Please apply today – we interview on a continuous basis. Please note that we do only accept applications through our recruitment system, hence no email applications will be considered.
 



 If you have questions, please contact Senior Talent Acquisition Partner Sophie Esphagen at sophie.esphagen@nordnet.se .
 



  





 We want to inform you that Nordnet conducts mandatory credit and background checks, as well as drug testing as part of our recruitment process.
 



  





 We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Infrastrukturarkitekt (datacenter)
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla infrastrukturen hos ett bolag vars tjänster måste fungera när samhället behöver dem som mest? Trivs du med att ta ägarskap över tekniska vägval och utveckla långsiktigt hållbara plattformar? Då kan det vara dig vi söker i rollen som Infrastrukturarkitekt till Teracom.
   

  

 Teracom ser till att radio, tv och beredskapskommunikation når fram när det verkligen gäller, oavsett om det råder solsken, storm eller kris. Som statligt bolag med över 100 års erfarenhet av samhällsviktig infrastruktur bygger och moderniserar vi den infrastruktur som Sverige är beroende av för att fungera i alla lägen. I den här rollen är du med och driver den fortsatta moderniseringen.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 I rollen som Infrastrukturarkitekt ansvarar du för att utveckla och vidareutveckla arkitekturen för Teracoms datacenter- och molnplattformar. Du får en central roll i arbetet med att säkerställa att infrastrukturen möter verksamhetens krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet, prestanda och skalbarhet. Samtidigt är du med och bygger den infrastrukturella grunden för Teracoms satsningar inom data, automation och AI.
   

  

 En viktig del av uppdraget är att vidareutveckla Teracoms hybridmiljö där verksamhetskritiska system samexisterar med moderna molntjänster.
   

  

 Tillsammans med arkitekter, specialister, driftorganisation och verksamhet identifierar du behov, tar fram lösningsförslag och omsätter dem till hållbara tekniska vägval. Du driver ett tvärfunktionellt team med kollegor från angränsande enheter där du sätter riktningen för infrastrukturdomänen. Du deltar också i förstudier, leverantörsdialog och upphandlingar och håller dig aktivt uppdaterad på teknikutvecklingen inom området.
   

  

 Mer om dig
   

  

 För att trivas i rollen är du självgående och tar ansvar för helheten. Du har förmågan att växla mellan långsiktiga perspektiv och tekniska detaljer och är trygg i att fatta beslut som påverkar komplexa plattformar och miljöer. Du är kommunikativ, prestigelös och van att samarbeta med många olika intressenter.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har:
   

  

* Djup teknisk kompetens inom datacenter
* Flerårig erfarenhet som infrastrukturarkitekt eller från en annan senior roll inom infrastruktur.
* God kunskap inom compute, lagring, nätverk och virtualisering
* Erfarenhet av hybridmiljöer.
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram arkitekturprinciper, standarder och tekniska riktlinjer.
* Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.
* Vana att samarbeta med flera olika team och intressenter.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


 Teracom är mitt i en automationsresa och erfarenhet av att införa automation i datacenter- eller infrastrukturmiljöer är därför särskilt meriterande, liksom förståelse för de infrastrukturella förutsättningarna för AI. Erfarenhet från samhällsviktig eller säkerhetsklassad verksamhet är också meriterande.
   

  

 Teracom erbjuder
   

  

 Du får marknadsmässiga villkor och goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. Förmåner inkluderar:
   

  

* Friskvårdsbidrag
* Rikskort eller subventionerat SL-kort
* Arbetstidsförkortning
* 2 friskvårdstimmar/vecka


 Mer information finns på Teracoms hemsida.
   

  

 Bra att känna till
   

  

 För anställning krävs godkänd drog- och alkoholtest samt att godkänd bakgrundskontroll liksom godkänd säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll genomförs. Detta eftersom anställningen innefattar säkerhetsklassning. Med anledning av detta krävs svenskt alternativt nordiskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Låter det här som en roll för dig? Då vill vi gärna höra ifrån dig. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande så tveka inte på att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. För frågor, kontakta Sara Åkerlund, sara.akerlund@ants.se.
   

  

 Om du inte redan känner Teracom
   

  

 Teracom samhällsnät bidrar till ett tryggare samhälle genom att våra tjänster ser till att information och kommunikation kan fungera för de allra viktigaste samhällsfunktionerna även i kris och krig. Våra uppdrag inkluderar utsändningen av public servicekanalerna för radio och tv, kommunikationslösningar och beredskapsuppdraget. Vi utvecklar och levererar också allt fler beredskapstjänster samt olika typer av kommunikationslösningar till totalförsvarsviktiga aktörer. Vi är ett statligt bolag med cirka 500 medarbetare på ett 50-tal orter i Sverige. Vår vision är att, tillsammans med våra uppdragsgivare, göra Sverige tryggare där det behövs, när det behövs.

title: Presales Engineer - HPE Networking
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
 At
 **Hewlett Packard Enterprise Networking** 
 we put customers and their experience first by challenging the old rules of networking. We actively work to solve their toughest challenges by connecting the dots between business and IT priorities. If you want to be in the forefront of innovation, advocate an easy-to-consume and ecosystem ready portfolio, HPE Networking is the place to be.
 **HPE Networking** 
 is a fast-moving, customer-focused environment where technology and business needs constantly intersect.
   

  

 As a
 **Presales Engineer,** 
 your role sits right in the middle of that intersection. You’re not just selling products—you’re translating complex networking solutions into real business value. That means working closely with customers to understand their challenges (like scalability, security, or hybrid work), then designing solutions using HPE’s portfolio.
   

  

**Day To Day, The Job Involves**
* Partnering with account managers to support deals technically
* Leading product demos, workshops, and proof-of-concepts
* Designing network architectures (campus, data center, edge, cloud)
* Explaining how solutions improve performance, security, and cost efficiency
* Staying current on trends like AI-driven networking and zero trust security


 The culture tends to reward curiosity and adaptability—you’re expected to keep learning, because both customer needs and networking technologies evolve quickly.
   

  

 Working in HPE Networking as a
 **Presales Engineer** 
 means being a trusted technical advisor - helping customers make confident decisions while bridging the gap between cutting-edge networking tech and practical business outcomes. Your ability to combine technical know-how and market intelligence grants you a position as an ambassador and technical expert. You will be the driving force behind the overall portfolio knowledge in all dimensions within your assigned customer territory.
   

  

**Client/customer Relationship**
* Maintain excellent communications with customers and partners in assigned customer or expertise area
* Represents HPE Networking as a technical expert in customer and partner meetings, forums or other events
* Drives opportunities with effective consultative techniques
* Builds customer loyalty through becoming a trusted advisor
* Partners effectively with others in the account team to ensure customer satisfaction
* The role will require business travels in Sweden (around 1-2 days/week)


**Solution Planning And Design**
* Building a strong technical expertise within certain areas of the HPE Networking portfolio
* Develop a good understanding of the overall HPE Networking portfolio
* Acquire at least one Expert certification
* Adapt proposal and design to customer requirements
* Establishes the validity of a solution and its components
* Identifies the growth path and scalability options of a solution for long term architectural positioning
* Articulate and clarify key aspects to implementation plans and setting expectations


**Team Collaboration**
* You are a team player who actively supports the account team with solution advice, proposals, presentations, and other customer communications.
* Analyzes and provides support to deals in the pipeline where needed.
* Transfers knowledge to peers via mentoring and actively participation in education programs.
* Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources within the company and partners.
* Facilitates a smooth transition from sales to implementation projects and design


 If you are…
   

  

* Fluent in Swedish and English which are the 2 working languages
* Holding an Engineering or University degree or extensive experience in designing and supporting complex enterprise networks
* Ideally having at least 3-6 years’ experience on the Solution Architect/System Engineer/Presales role, mainly acquired with a manufacturer and/or an integrator
* Excellent in communication, presentation and negotiation
* Having good knowledge on HPE networking latest technologies and solutions, as well as competitive solutions
* Able to understand technical innovations and trends, customer value chains and business requirements


 Join us and make your mark!
   

  

**What We Can Offer You**
**Health & Wellbeing**
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

**Personal & Professional Development**
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
   

  

**Unconditional Inclusion**
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
   

  

**Let's Stay Connected**

title: Solutions Architect - Nordics
description:
**Who are we?**
 Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
   

  

 We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
   

  

 We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
   

  

 We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
   

  

**Why this role?**
 In this role as a founding Solutions Architect for Cohere in the Nordics, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s business in both the Nordics territory and the wider European region. You will partner with account executives, partners, and our executive leadership team to communicate and demonstrate the value of our technology to the market, and build on the success of our flagship customers, like Saab, TKMS and Thales.
   

  

 SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits:
   

  

* Technical experts in the field
* Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues
* Product evangelists of Cohere technology
* Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI


 Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products.
   

  

 In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers.
   

  

 As the technical relationship owner, you will collaborate with stakeholders to understand their business objectives and translate those into our technical solutions. You will take ownership of the customer narrative, serving as the voice of the customer and acting as a liaison between the customer and our product team. Additionally, you will provide guidance on best practices for using Cohere, identify areas for improvement within the platform, and cultivate technical champions within customer organizations to drive adoption and gather feedback to enhance our products.
   

  

**A Typical Day At Cohere Might Include**
* Leading the technical talk track on customer calls.
* Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments.
* Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology.
* Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots.
* Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere.
* Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs.
* Working closely with our partners to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers.


**This might be for you if you have some of the following:**
* 3+ years of customer-facing technical pre/post sales Solutions Architect/Solutions Engineer/Sales Engineer/Digital Strategy Consultant (or similar) experience.
* A passion for Generative AI, and an understanding of strengths and weaknesses of Generative LLMs and AI technologies.
* Familiarity with foundational ML concepts (training, evaluation, etc.)
* Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences.
* Thrives within ambiguous and uncharted environments
* You can identify and implement high-impact processes in unstructured environments.
* Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools
* Preferred: 2+ years architecting, deploying or consulting on NLP/AI/LLM Solutions
* Preferred: Fluency in Swedish, Danish or Norwegian
* Must have: Professional fluency in English (business and technical)


*Please note: for this role we are open to a range of experience levels, from Associate to Staff-level Individual Contributors (ICs). Experience level stated is a bare minimum.*
**Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks**
* A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
* Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.
* RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.
* 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.
* Annual enrichment benefits:


 Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   

  

 Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.
   

  

* 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)
* Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.


**How And Where We Work**
* Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.
* For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.
* For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.
* Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.


 If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.
   

  

 We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.
   

  

 We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.
   

  

*Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our* 
*official careers* 
*page.*

title: AI Engineer - FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer)
description:
**Req ID: CSQ427R332**
**Mission**
 The AI Forward Deployed Engineering (AI FDE) team is a highly specialized customer-facing AI team at Databricks. We deliver professional services engagements to help our customers build and productionize first-of-its-kind AI applications. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations, as well as support internal subject matter expert (SME) teams. We view our team as an ensemble: we look for individuals with strong, unique specializations to improve the overall strength of the team. This team is the right fit for you if you love working with customers, teammates, and fueling your curiosity for the latest trends in GenAI, LLMOps, and ML more broadly.
   

  

**We welcome remote applicants located near our offices. Preferred locations: Amsterdam, NL**
 Reporting to: Senior Manager - AI FDE, EMEA
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have**
* Develop cutting-edge GenAI solutions, incorporating the latest techniques from Databricks AI research to solve customer problems
* Own production rollouts of consumer and internally facing GenAI applications
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers across a variety of domains
* Present at conferences such as Data + AI Summit, recognized as a thought leader internally and externally
* Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to influence priorities and shape the product roadmap


**What We Look For**
* Experience building GenAI applications, including RAG, multi-agent systems, Text2SQL, fine-tuning, etc., with tools such as HuggingFace, LangChain, and DSPy
* Expertise in deploying production-grade GenAI applications, including evaluation and optimizations
* Extensive years of hands-on industry data science experience, leveraging common machine learning and data science tools, i.e. pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, etc.
* Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
* Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike
* Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through AI
* [Preferred] Experience using the Databricks Intelligence Platform and Apache Spark™ to process large-scale distributed datasets
* Willing to travel once every 4-8 weeks to see customers (as needed)


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
   

  

**Benefits**

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Company** 




 NestAI is a European AI lab for defence delivering the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. We develop adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions.
 



  





 NestOS is our open, modular, and interoperable platform that enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI brings together over 150 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a
 **Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** 
 to join our team full-time in Stockholm, or with the ability to commute to Stockholm metropolitan area around 3 days per week.
 



  





 As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing eiher in
 **Artificial Intelligence, Embedded Systems or Full Stack Engineering** 
 , you manage the technical delivery and integration of NestAI’s autonomous systems for our partners. Embedded directly within key partner initiatives, FDE squads shorten the path from development to fielded capability, validating product features where assumptions are tested against operational reality.
 



  





 This is not a standard implementation role; it is a high-stakes engineering position where you tailor our platforms to the complex, real-world environments of our most critical partners. We are looking for a senior builder who understands that in mission-critical domains, "good enough" doesn't exist. You will bring a high degree of architectural depth to solve problems where software meets hardware in the physical world.
 



  





**Day-to-day responsibilities include:** 



* **Mission-Specific Engineering:** 
 Technical leadership for client projects, taking full ownership of technical decisions to rapidly deploy and customize our platforms to specific client needs.
* **Architectural Integration:** 
 Design, develop, and deploy solutions that connect edge devices, UAV sensors, and situational intelligence platforms into a cohesive operational picture supporting customer operating environments.
* **AI-Driven Development:** 
 Utilize AI-driven development workflows to accelerate delivery cycles with our platforms without compromising the sovereign and reliable core of our systems.
* **Collaborative Problem Solving:** 
 Work closely with client technical teams and internal product R&D to translate complex field requirements into scalable product features. Create rapid prototypes to explore future client aspirations.
* **Technical Leadership:** 
 Act as the primary technical point of contact for customer engagements, providing the architectural "glue" between disparate data sources and decision-support interfaces.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Generalist Mindset & Adaptability:** 
 A versatile generalist profile; you enjoy changing scenery, adapt quickly to unfamiliar codebases, and feel comfortable operating across diverse technical ecosystems.
* A deep technical foundation and 5+ years of experience in at least one of the following:
 **Cloud, AI, Edge/Embedded Computing, Machine Learning, or Data Engineering** 
 .
* A proven ability to think in "spatial" terms—understanding how AI interacts with physical environments and complex hardware architectures.
* You communicate fluently both in English and Swedish. You also have excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to confidently collaborate with external partners, translate business/operational needs into engineering reality, and lead client-facing deployments.
* Mindset: You thrive in "mission-first" environments and possess the Nordic engineering ethos of building systems that earn trust through performance, not promises.
* Ability to travel occasionally (up to 10% of worktime) to client sites within Europe to ensure field-proven performance.
* **Pluses:** 
 Previous consulting or customer-facing engineering experience. Prior background in defence, aerospace, robotics, or related physical AI domains.



  





**Why join NestAI** 




 At NestAI, you’ll build meaningful, real-world technology as part of a world-class team of engineers, scientists, and experienced professionals. You’ll work on systems where reliability genuinely matters, contribute to Europe’s security and resilience, and solve problems that demand depth, trust, and craftsmanship.
 



  





 If you want to build with purpose — and with leading experts in the field — you’ve come to the right place.
 



  





**Practicalities** 




 Employment is subject to applicable security screening.
 



  





 NestAI is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants based on their skills, experience, and potential.
 



  





 We are currently unable to provide visa sponsorship or international relocation support for this position. Candidates must already be based in Sweden or in the EU and have a valid work permit for this region at the time of application.

title: Management Consultant, Data & AI (Manager/Senior Manager) - Stockholm
description:
Vi på Capgemini Invent tror på att olikheter driver förändring. Som transformationskonsulter förenar vi strategiska, kreativa och vetenskapliga kompetenser och samarbetar nära våra kunder för att leverera lösningar i framkant. Bli en del av oss och driv transformation anpassad efter våra kunders utmaningar. Med vetenskap och data som grund, kreativitet och design som drivkraft – och teknik skapad med syfte som möjliggörare.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




  





 Som en del av vårt Data & AI-team hjälper du våra kunder att bli mer datadrivna och att skapa affärsvärde genom data, analys och AI. Du stöttar organisationer i att utveckla de strategier, styrningsmodeller, arbetssätt och tekniska förmågor som krävs för att lyckas med sin data- och AI-transformation – från strategi och utforskande till implementering och skalning. Vi söker flera senioritetsnivåer, från
 **Manager** 
 till
 **Senior Manager** 
 . Vilken nivå som erbjuds kommer att baseras på kandidatens erfarenhet, kompetens och tidigare meriter.
 



  





 Hos oss kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i att:
 



  




* Hjälpa våra kunder att förstå vilken påverkan data och AI har på strategisk, taktisk och operativ nivå samt omsätta insikter till konkreta affärsresultat.
* Utforma och utveckla data- och AI-strategier, styrningsmodeller (Governance) och initiativ för att stärka datadriven kultur och beslutsfattande.
* Stödja kunder i att använda och styra sina datatillgångar för att uppnå strategiska mål och skapa ökat affärsvärde.
* Leda eller bidra till utvecklingen av moderna dataplattformar och analysförmågor som möjliggör tillgång till tillförlitlig data av hög kvalitet.
* Rådgiva kunder kring AI-adoption, AI-drivna innovationer och utveckling av användningsfall som skapar mätbara effekter.
* Arbeta med innovativa frågeställningar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, strategi, data och AI.
* Leda eller bidra till transformationsprogram inom data, analys, AI, process mining och intelligent automation.
* Bygga starka relationer med kunder och intressenter samt, beroende på senioritetsnivå, bidra till affärsutveckling, försäljningsinitiativ och anbudsarbete.
* Coacha och utveckla teammedlemmar samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveranser och projekt.



  





**Din profil** 




  





 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av, eller ett starkt intresse för, ett eller flera områden inom data och AI, kombinerat med erfarenhet av data- och analysdriven transformation. Du har exempelvis arbetat med data- och AI-strategi, governance eller moderna dataplattformar och dataarkitekturer, såsom Snowflake eller Databricks. Du är van att omsätta data till verksamhetsnytta genom analytics, datavisualisering och beslutsstöd, och har gärna erfarenhet av process mining eller intelligent automation.
 



  





 Vi ser också gärna att du har kunskap inom AI-adoption, utveckling och skalning av AI-use cases samt AI-arkitektur och större AI-transformationer på företagsnivå. Erfarenhet av data- och AI-regelefterlevnad är meriterande, liksom ett intresse för nya teknologier och arbetssätt inom området, exempelvis agentbaserad AI (Agentic AI). Som person drivs du av att skapa värde genom data och AI och trivs i en miljö där innovation kombineras med affärsfokus.
 



  





**Vi ser även att du har:** 




  




* Erfarenhet från management consulting eller liknande rådgivande roller.
* Stark kommunikativ förmåga och erfarenhet av att samarbeta med och hantera intressenter på olika nivåer i en organisation.
* Förmåga att omsätta affärsbehov till konkreta data- och analyslösningar och fungera som bryggan mellan verksamhet och teknik.
* Erfarenhet av att leda initiativ, projekt eller team.
* Erfarenhet av affärsutveckling, kundbearbetning och anbudsarbete.
* Masterexamen med inriktning mot ekonomi, teknik, IT eller Data & Analytics.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska samt giltigt arbetstillstånd i Sverige.



  





**Det här får du hos oss** 




  




* **Meningsfull påverkan** 
 Hjälp organisationer att frigöra värdet i sina data och AI-satsningar för att stärka konkurrenskraft, effektivitet och långsiktigt affärsvärde.
* **Innovation i framkant** 
 Arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan verksamhet, strategi, data och AI med de senaste metoderna, teknologierna och arbetssätten.
* **Karriärutveckling** 
 Utveckla din kompetens genom utbildningar, certifieringar, mentorskap och spännande uppdrag hos ledande organisationer.
* **Samarbete och kunskapsdelning** 
 Bli en del av ett inkluderande team där nyfikenhet, samarbete och entreprenörsanda står i fokus.



  





**Bra att veta** 




  





 Placering: För denna roll utgår du från vårt centralt belägna kontor i Stockholm och är redo att resa till kund vid behov. Senioritet och titel fastställs baserat på din bakgrund och erfarenhet.
 **Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomförs identitetskontroll via ID‑handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma vid behov** 




  





**Om Capgemini** 




  





 Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.
 



  





 Make it real |
 **www.capgemini.com**

description:

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and
 **one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.** 
 We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build
 **workplace technology** 
 that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to
 **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** 
 Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best,
 **we need brilliant people** 
 on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why should you apply? 🌟**
* Impact: work on a product suite used by millions of people that improves employee experience and wellbeing.
* Scale: a big focus of our engineering teams is building features and services to support our customers globally.
* Autonomy: have an input into the product roadmap and technically lead features/services.
* Development: this is a crucial part of our aim to ensure a seamless experience across FPS.
* Top 10 Employer, Sunday Times Best Places to Work Awards
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and benefits space


**Role Overview 🚀**
 As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will work across frontend and backend areas that support Benifex employee experience products, mobile app, and platform look and feel.
   

  

 The team is responsible for operational continuity, technical stability, and continuous improvement beyond the product roadmap, which means the work often involves balancing new development with careful maintenance, refactoring, and production reliability.
   

  

 This role suits someone who enjoys complex domains, established systems, and end-to-end ownership. You will contribute to frontend development in React, TypeScript, and Angular, while also designing and maintaining backend services, APIs, and integrations using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL.
   

  

 We are also on a journey to use AI more deliberately in our daily engineering work. We are looking for someone who has practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows, or who wants to keep exploring how these tools can help us move faster, improve quality, understand complex codebases, and reduce repetitive work without lowering our engineering standards.
   

  

**Great Benefits**
 🧠 ITP1 pension.
   

  

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
   

  

 📝 Collective agreement.
   

  

 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
   

  

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
   

  

 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
   

  

 💰 Referral bonuses.
   

  

 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
   

  

 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
   

  

**Responsibilities 🤘**
* Design, build, and maintain fullstack features across employee experience products and platform UI areas.
* Build frontend functionality in React and TypeScript and support existing Angular-based applications.
* Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and data flows using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL.
* Integrate frontend experiences with reliable, well-designed APIs and platform services.
* Safely evolve a large, long-lived codebase through incremental refactoring and technical debt reduction.
* Treat reliability, security, performance, accessibility, and maintainability as core parts of delivery.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and knowledge-sharing.
* Help investigate bugs and production issues, identify root causes, and prevent recurring problems.
* Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical decisions within the team.
* Use AI-assisted and agentic coding tools thoughtfully as part of daily development, code exploration, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
* Help the team learn where AI adds value, where human judgement is still essential, and how to use these tools responsibly in a complex production codebase.


**What are we looking for? 🔎**
* Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL: Needed to build and maintain backend services, APIs, and data-driven functionality.
* React, TypeScript, and Angular: Needed to contribute across both future frontend development and existing FPS frontend areas.
* API design and integration: Important for creating dependable interfaces between frontend, backend, and platform services.
* Testing, CI/CD, and observability: Needed to deliver reliable changes and diagnose issues in production-like environments.
* AI-assisted and agentic coding: Practical experience using AI coding tools to explore codebases, generate or refactor code, write tests, support reviews, or accelerate delivery while maintaining strong engineering judgement.


**Please note:** 
 Our recruitment process will begin in mid-to-late August, once the hiring team has returned from their summer holidays. We appreciate your patience and look forward to reviewing your application.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving and reading your application!
   

  

**Our Interview Process ✌**
 Benifex understand the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible, typically a 2-2.5 week timeframe.
   

  

 📞 Initial informal call with the Talent team
   

  

 ⏳ Interview with our Engineering Director 30-45 min
   

  

 🧪 Technical Task
   

  

 🔎 Technical Interview - 60 min
   

  

 🤩 Final interview with VP of Engineering - 30-45 min
   

  

  

  

**We are a proud member of the Disability Confident employer scheme.**
**If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage during the recruitment process, please let us know with your application.**

title: BI & Digital Tools Manager
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*
 Your role
   

  

 Operational Excellence is a newly formed department consisting of three sections, one of which is BI & Digital Tools. You will be part of the Operational Excellence FCC Leadership Team and will play a key role in shaping the new department together with your fellow managers.
   

  

 As Manager, BI & Digital Tools, you will lead a high-performing team specializing in business intelligence, automation, and machine learning. The team consists of talented professionals who design and develop digital tools, methods, dashboards, reports, and predictive models. Its mission is to strengthen decision-making and transform the way we work by leveraging data, developing innovative digital solutions, and ensuring their successful implementation and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Your primary focus will be the managers and colleagues within Operations Stockholm, but you will also work closely with departments within Surveillance business units Fighter Core Capabilities as well as Business Area Surveillance Operational Excellence department.
   

  

 Your responsibilities in short:
   

  

* Manage the BI & Digital Tools team, ensuring high performance, engagement, and efficient ways of working.
* Drive the transformation towards a more data-driven organization by translating data into meaningful KPIs, insights, and decision support across the business.
* Develop, own, and execute the organization's data governance roadmap.
* Translate the Operational Excellence roadmap and strategic goals into actionable roadmaps and priorities for BI & Digital Tools.
* Partner and collaborate with the sister sections within Operational Excellence to ensure data and digital solutions are integral parts of business initiatives.
* Coach and develop your team, building capabilities and enabling employees to take on increasingly complex challenges.
* Empower your employees through value-based leadership.
* Develop efficient ways of working, implement best practices, and drive continuous improvement within your area.
* Act as a transformation and change leader, inspiring confidence and engagement in an evolving and agile business environment.
* Build, maintain and develop relations with all relevant stakeholders.
* Translating Saab, Surveillance and BU strategies into clear and well-communicated targets for your stakeholders
* Leading according to Saab´s organizational values.
* Full responsibility for results within your area, which includes safety and health, quality, delivery capacity, efficiency and finance.


 Your profile
   

  

 We are looking for a positive, curious, and self-driven leader who brings energy, structure, and a strategic mindset to create a collaborative and high-performing environment. You are a team player who actively contributes to shared objectives and business success.
   

  

 You are an inspiring and inclusive leader with the ability to recognize and develop each team member’s strengths and potential. Through clear communication, strong values, and direction, you create commitment and successfully lead people through change. description:

 Vi söker nu en Salesforce & Automation Specialist som vill vara med och utveckla Salesforce som en central del av vår affär. Du får samtidigt vara en del av vår förändringsresa, där vi ställer om hur vi använder IT. Vår ambition är att våra system ska hänga ihop och tillsammans skapa effektiva processer som driver vår verksamhet framåt.
 



  





 Du blir därför en viktig förstärkning i ett team som just nu driver flera initiativ inom Salesforce, integration, automation och AI.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som Salesforce & Automation Specialist kommer du att arbeta med att utveckla, konfigurera och förbättra våra processer i Salesforce. Det kan handla om allt från datamodeller, rapporter och användarflöden till mer avancerade affärsprocesser och automationer. Salesforce är en central plattform i vår systemarkitektur och en viktig del av hur vi driver affären framåt.
 



  





 I rollen kommer du också att arbeta med vår automationsplattform för integration, automation och AI, där vi kopplar samman Salesforce med andra delar av vår systemmiljö och bygger automatiserade processer mellan våra plattformar.
 



  





 Hos oss får du en verksamhetsnära roll inom Group IT där du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor inom bland annat Sales, Marketing, Operations och Finance. I teamet finns även Salesforce-utvecklare som arbetar med mer avancerad utveckling, och du kommer att arbeta nära dem för att omsätta verksamhetens behov till fungerande lösningar.
 



  





 Du kommer bland annat att:
 


* Konfigurera och vidareutveckla Salesforce utifrån verksamhetens behov
* Bygga och förbättra flöden, automationer, rapporter och funktionalitet i Salesforce
* Arbeta med datakvalitet, struktur och processer i CRM miljön
* Bygga integrationer och automatiserade processer i vår automationsplattform
* Använda automation och AI för att förenkla och effektivisera affärsprocesser
* Omsätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar tillsammans med våra Salesforce-utvecklare
* Vara delaktig i prioritering, kravställning och koordinering av utvecklingsarbetet
* Stötta Sales, Marketing och Operations i utvecklingen av effektiva digitala processer
* Skapa de tekniska förutsättningarna för automatiserade kundresor, leadflöden och reconnect flöden
* Bidra i utvecklingen av vår CPQ lösning och andra affärskritiska flöden kopplade till Salesforce
* Identifiera var integration, automation och AI kan ersätta manuella arbetsmoment
* Vara med och utveckla vår framtida CRM arkitektur och hur Salesforce samverkar med resten av vår systemmiljö



  





**🌍 Life as a Power Shifter - Vad erbjuder vi dig** 




 ·
 **Möjligheten att Make an Impact** 
 – ditt arbete bidrar direkt till att fixa planeten och driva energiomställningen.
 



 ·

 - läs mer om våra värderingar
 
 här

 *power up* 
 i takt med att vi och energibranschen utvecklas.

 - olika perspektiv driver innovation, hos oss kan du vara dig själv och bidra med dina erfarenheter, identiteter och idéer.
 



 ·
 **Trygga villkor -** 
 Tjänstepension, 30 semesterdagar, friskvårdsbidrag, parkering m.m.
 



 ·

 jobba upp till två dagar i veckan hemifrån.
 



  





 Vill du se hur livet hos oss faktiskt ser ut? Följ oss på Instagram:
 
 @LifeAtSveaSolar
 




  





**Är vi en match?** 




 För att trivas och lyckas i denna roll så ser vi att du har erfarenhet av Salesforce och gillar att förstå både tekniken och verksamheten bakom den.
 



  





 Du behöver inte vara utvecklare, men du behöver förstå hur Salesforce är uppbyggt och känna dig bekväm med att konfigurera plattformen, förstå data och processer och diskutera lösningar med både utvecklare och verksamheten.
 



  





 Vi tror också att du är en person som gärna frågar: Varför gör vi det här manuellt när vi skulle kunna automatisera det?
 



  





 Du behöver inte kunna alla våra verktyg från början. För oss är nyfikenhet, problemlösningsförmåga och viljan att lära sig nya tekniker minst lika viktigt.
 



  





 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
 


* Salesforce administration och konfiguration
* Salesforce Flow och automation
* CRM processer inom exempelvis Sales, Marketing eller Operations
* Datamodellering och datakvalitet i Salesforce
* Rapportering och dashboards
* Kravställning och verksamhetsnära systemutveckling
* Integrationer och API



  




* Meriterande:
* Förståelse för automations- och integrationsplattformar
* Kunskap inom CPQ
* Erfarenhet av Salesforce utveckling, exempelvis Apex och Lightning Web Components
* Förståelse för Marketing Automation och design av automatiserade kundresor
* Erfarenhet av att samarbeta och koordinera med utvecklare



  





 Listan kan kännas lång, men ingen är bäst i alla kategorier. Sök om du känner igen dig någorlunda.😊

 Svea Solar är en av Sveriges - och en av Europas - ledande aktörer inom energiteknik samt leverantör av solenergi och smarta energilösningar. Vi hjälper våra kunder att optimera sin energianvändning med solpaneler, värmepumpar, batterier, laddboxar, elavtal och vår egen mjukvara. Vi kallar det
 **The Power Shift.** 
 Och vi som driver det framåt?
 **Power Shifters.**

* Alla kandidater bedöms på lika villkor, med strukturerade frågor och tester via
 
 Alva Labs
 
 för att säkerställa en rättvis och inkluderande process.
* Läs mer om vår
 
 rekryteringsprocess här.



  




* 👉

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
**CTO / Regional Technical Founder** 




**Hyper-growth Enterprise AI Scale-up** 




**Location: Sweden** 




**Salary: Market-leading salary + bonus + stock** 




  





**The Role** 




 We’re hiring a senior technology professional to play a key role in the next stage of the company’s growth. This is a broad position with exposure across the business. You’ll work with senior stakeholders, customers, and technical teams, helping turn complex requirements into practical solutions while contributing to the development of the wider organisation.
 



 The ideal person will enjoy variety, autonomy, and being close to the technology rather than operating purely at a strategic level.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Provide technical leadership on high-priority projects and customer opportunities.
* Help evaluate requirements and determine the best approach to solving complex problems.
* Work alongside commercial teams where technical input is important.
* Partner with engineers on challenging projects and contribute directly when appropriate.
* Help improve the way technical projects are planned, delivered, and supported.
* Develop and mentor engineers and other technical professionals.
* Work with senior leadership to identify opportunities to improve the technology organisation.
* Build trusted relationships with important customers and external stakeholders.
* Help resolve difficult technical issues and ensure the right people are involved.
* Contribute to decisions around technology, product direction, and future capabilities.
* Introduce practical processes and standards as the business continues to grow.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Strong background in software engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Experience working at a senior level within a technology company.
* A track record of solving complex technical problems in real-world environments.
* Comfortable communicating with engineers, executives, customers, and commercial teams.
* Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or similarly entrepreneurial environment.
* Some experience managing, mentoring, or developing technical talent.
* Commercial awareness and an ability to understand the wider business context.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy.
* Based in Stockholm or able to work regularly from London.
* Curious about new technology and particularly interested in the development and practical application of AI.

title: Senior Business Consultant
description:
**SUPPORT OUR GROWTH PLANS** 
 AS OUR NEXT SENIOR BUSINESS CONSULTANT
   

  

 Lead customers through complex ERP transformation initiatives, combining deep expertise in
 **Distribution, Supply Chain, Warehouse Management, Inventory, and Logistics** 
 with strong consulting and commercial skills. You’ll act as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them understand their challenges, design effective ERP solutions, and turn business requirements into measurable outcomes.
   

  

 This is a customer-facing role for an experienced consultant who is equally comfortable leading discovery workshops, shaping end-to-end solutions, supporting ERP implementations, and helping win new business through compelling demonstrations and solution presentations.
   

  

**WHAT AWAITS YOU AT IPTOR:**
* Professional Development: We're committed to fostering professional development and career growth. Our comprehensive training and development programs empower employees to reach their full potential.
* A Collaborative and Innovative culture: At Iptor, our culture thrives on recognition, trust, and respect. We foster an inclusive and supportive environment valuing everyone’s contributions. We recognize dedication through an attractive salary package, bonuses, and generous vacation days. Our success is built upon collaboration and innovation.


*Get a full overview at:* 
*Careers - Iptor*
**YOUR HELP AND CONTRIBUTIONS TO OUR JOURNEY**
* Lead customer discovery and requirements-gathering workshops to understand business needs and operational challenges.
* Analyze and document current-state and future-state business processes.
* Provide expert guidance across Distribution, Warehouse Management, Logistics, Inventory Management, Replenishment, and Supply Chain processes.
* Design end-to-end ERP solutions covering Distribution, Logistics, Warehousing, Inventory, Procurement, and Financial integration.
* Facilitate solution design, gap analysis, process optimization, and business transformation activities.
* Define functional requirements and business process improvements that deliver measurable customer value.
* Support ERP implementation teams through configuration, testing, training, deployment, and go-live activities.
* Collaborate closely with Project Managers, Solution Architects, Technical Consultants, and Development teams.
* Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, efficient, and aligned with customer requirements and industry best practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders, from operational managers through to senior and executive leadership.
* Support sales teams throughout the sales cycle, from discovery through solution development and proposal.
* Conduct customer workshops and deliver engaging ERP demonstrations tailored to specific business requirements.
* Prepare and present solution proposals, business cases, value propositions, and ROI-focused recommendations.
* Participate in RFP, RFI, and tender responses.
* Clearly communicate the business value, benefits, and potential ROI of ERP solutions to prospective customers.
* Represent the company at customer meetings, industry events, and conferences.
* Stay up to date with ERP trends, emerging technologies, and developments across Distribution, Supply Chain, Warehousing, and Logistics.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the development of consulting capabilities, methodologies, and best practices.
* Contribute to successful, profitable project delivery and help identify opportunities for continuous improvement.


**YOU STAND OUT FROM THE CROWD** 
 IF YOU HAVE
   

  

 To be both successful and motivated in this role, we think you recognize yourself in some (or all) of the below:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in ERP consulting, business consulting, or a similar customer-facing role.
* Proven experience delivering ERP implementations in Distribution, Logistics, Warehousing, or Supply Chain environments.
* Deep understanding of Distribution Management, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Inventory Management, Supply Chain Operations, Logistics & Transportation, Procurement, and Replenishment.
* Strong understanding of ERP integration touchpoints across operations and finance.
* Experience with complex, multi-site, or international ERP implementations.
* Proven ability to design and document end-to-end business processes.
* Experience working with warehouse operations and WMS integrations, including mobile warehouse technologies.
* Knowledge of replenishment, forecasting, inventory optimization, and supply chain planning.
* Experience with Customer Managed Inventory (CMI), Replenishment & Requirements Planning (R&R), or broader distribution ecosystems is an advantage.
* Strong business process analysis, problem-solving, and solution design skills.
* Excellent customer-facing consulting and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to challenge and influence stakeholders constructively while building strong, trusted relationships.
* Confident in facilitating workshops and discussions with senior management and executive stakeholders.
* Strong ERP demonstration and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor complex solutions to business audiences.
* Experience supporting sales pursuits, proposals, RFPs, RFIs, and customer presentations.
* Strong commercial awareness and ability to articulate business value and ROI.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences.
* Project leadership or solution lead experience is an advantage.
* ERP certifications are a plus.


**INCLUSION AND DIVERSITY**
 At Iptor, diversity and inclusion are at the core of our values. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and excellence. We foster an inclusive workplace where every individual's contributions are celebrated and respected. Join us in creating an environment where each individual's unique contributions shape our success. 🌟

 Tereza Tencheva

title: Senior DBA DB2 z/OS Mainframe Platform
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

 Vi söker en erfaren DB2-expert som vill ta en nyckelroll i ett globalt team med fokus på affärskritiska system. Hos oss arbetar du med en stabil och strategisk plattform som är central för verksamheten – och du får möjlighet att påverka framtidens lösningar i en långsiktig och moderniseringsinriktad miljö.
   

  

**Om rollen:**
 Som Senior DB2 Database Administrator (DBA) blir du en del av Global Technology Operations (GTO) – en internationell enhet som ansvarar för robusta och innovativa lösningar för affärskritiska system. Rollen är strategisk och långsiktig, med fokus på stabilitet, säkerhet och kontinuerlig utveckling av mainframe-miljön.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

* Drift, administration och optimering av DB2-databaser på mainframe (z/OS).
* Prestanda- och kapacitetsplanering samt tuning av databaser.
* Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet och robusta backup-/recovery-processer.
* Delta i design, implementering och migrering av nya lösningar.
* Felsökning och problemlösning i samarbete med utvecklings- och driftteam.
* Dokumentation och efterlevnad av interna och externa regelverk.


**Om teamet:**
 Du ingår i ett erfaret DBA-team med flera kompetenta kollegor, där kunskapsdelning och samarbete är centralt. Vi arbetar med långsiktiga leveranser och affärskritiska system – här får du möjlighet att bygga djup kompetens och påverka strategiska beslut i en stabil och global organisation. Teamet präglas av öppenhet, samarbete och en kultur där vi stöttar varandra för att nå gemensamma mål.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

* Minst 10 års erfarenhet av DB2 på mainframe-plattform (z/OS).
* Djup kompetens inom DB2-arkitektur, performance tuning och disaster recovery samt tillhörande utilities.
* Goda kunskaper i CABDB2 eller motsvarande produkt.
* Erfarenhet av stora, komplexa miljöer med höga krav på säkerhet och tillgänglighet.
* God förståelse för mainframe-teknologier och relaterade verktyg.
* Erfarenhet eller kunskap om IBM Infosphere Data Replication samt Control-M är önskvärt men inget krav.


**Personliga egenskaper:**
 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har följande styrkor:
   

  

* Självständig och initiativrik – du tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och driver förbättringar från idé till genomförande.
* Analytisk och strukturerad – du kan snabbt identifiera komplexa samband, prioritera rätt och arbeta metodiskt för att nå resultat.
* Problemlösningsorienterad – du ser utmaningar som möjligheter och agerar proaktivt för att förebygga och lösa problem.
* Kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad – du förklarar tekniska frågor på ett tydligt sätt och trivs med att dela kunskap i teamet.
* Utvecklingsinriktad – du är nyfiken på nya teknologier och bidrar aktivt till modernisering och förbättringar.


**Meriterande:**
* Erfarenhet av automatisering och skriptning (REXX, JCL).
* Kunskap om modernisering av mainframe-lösningar och integration med distribuerade system.
* Certifieringar inom DB2 eller mainframe-teknologier.


**Vi erbjuder:**
* En nyckelroll i en global organisation med affärskritiska system.
* Möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad teknik och modernisering av mainframe.
* Kompetensutveckling och långsiktiga karriärmöjligheter.


**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

 Stockholm

With 600,000 experts globally and 18,000+ consultants working for leading Nordic Customers, we have a strong sense of purpose for the ecosystem around us – our employees, partners, customers and society.
 



  





**About the role** 




**Technology works best when people can rely on it.** 
 As an IT Support Engineer, you will be a visible and trusted point of contact for colleagues who need practical, high-quality technical support. You will solve issues across devices, applications, connectivity and workplace technology, while contributing to smooth daily operations in a modern enterprise environment.
 



 This is an opportunity to build broad technical experience, work with both local and global teams, and see the immediate impact of your work. If you enjoy troubleshooting, helping people and taking ownership from first contact through resolution, this role offers a strong platform for continued development.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Provide hands-on onsite support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, printers and other workplace technology.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software and connectivity issues, and coordinate with specialist teams when needed.
* Set up, deploy, replace and retire devices while maintaining accurate asset and inventory records.
* Support meeting-room technology, audio-visual equipment, collaboration tools and wired or wireless connectivity.
* Contribute during upgrades, office moves and workplace transformation initiatives, with clear documentation throughout.
* Identify recurring issues and share ideas that improve service quality, knowledge management and the employee experience.



  





**About you** 




**You combine technical curiosity with a genuine service mindset.** 
 You communicate clearly, stay calm when priorities change and enjoy working directly with users. You take ownership, pay attention to detail and collaborate well across teams. Just as importantly, you are motivated to keep learning as workplace technology evolves.
 



  





**Qualifications:** 



* At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT support, desktop support, field services or end-user computing.
* Hands-on experience supporting users in a corporate or enterprise environment.
* Good knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams and Active Directory or identity-management concepts.
* Working knowledge of IT service-management tools and network fundamentals such as TCP/IP, LAN, Wi-Fi and VPN.
* Experience with device lifecycle and asset management; exposure to MacBook support and Microsoft Intune is valuable.
* A degree or diploma in IT, computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Fluent in
 **English** 
 (written and spoken)



  





**What we offer** 



* Wellness Allowance
* Collective Agreement with the Union Coverage
* Competitive Pension Plan (ITP1)
* Salary Sacrifice Pension Scheme through SPP
* Pension Advisory Services through SPP
* Skandia Group Insurances
* Access to the Benifex Benefits Portal with Exclusive Discounts
* Continuous Learning, Training and Development Opportunities
* Access to world-class learning platforms
* Long-Term Career Growth within a Global Organization



  





**Ready to make an impact?** 




 Join a company where innovation, collaboration and continuous development are part of everyday life!
 



  





 You are welcome to submit your CV via LinkedIn. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

**Silvina.sandberg1@tcs.com**
